title: Senior Tech Services Engineer
description:
**Overview**
JD - Senior Technical Services Engineer
  
  
Position Overview:
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Technical Services Engineer to join our customer support team and provide expert application support for our state-of-the-art healthcare solutions. This role is ideal for a seasoned professional with experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications and a strong desire to deepen product expertise
  
  
while delivering exceptional customer service.
  
  
As part of the Support Engineering team, you will:
  
  

* Troubleshoot complex issues and enhance the user experience for HealthEdge customers.
* Provide technical support to both internal and external clients across hosted and on-premises environments.
* Leverage your proficiency in Java-based technologies and frameworks to resolve issues efficiently.
* Collaborate with IT, operations, product development, product management, and other stakeholders

to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
  
  

* Utilize a broad range of technologies and develop deep knowledge of HealthEdge products to ensure high-quality support delivery.

This is a customer-facing role that requires strong technical acumen, problem-solving skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  
  
The Product:
  
  
HealthRules® Payer is the core of our integrated solution suite, offering a leading digital, next-generation claims administration processing system. It includes advanced business intelligence, seamless integration, a unique configuration and promotion engine, and comprehensive home and host processing—available on both public and private clouds. HealthRules Payer consistently ranks #1 among CAPS solutions, delivering 90–97% first-pass auto-adjudication rates and over 99% accuracy. It empowers payers to respond swiftly to regulatory changes, adopt value-based reimbursement models, and improve clinical outcomes and member experiences.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Analyze complex technical problems, identify root causes, and effectively communicate findings to both customers and product development teams.
* Manage multiple support cases with competing priorities, ensuring accurate documentation and customer information is maintained in Salesforce.
* Perform in-depth root cause analysis and correlate issues across systems and applications to drive

resolution.
  
  

* Demonstrate a proactive, solution-oriented mindset, consistently seeking opportunities to enhance service quality, operational efficiency, and team performance.
* Assist customers in diagnosing issues quickly, providing effective workarounds, and guiding them on best practices and cleanup procedures.
* Participate in customer calls, peer reviews, and cross-functional discussions to identify optimal solutions and contribute to continuous improvement.
* Provide detailed feedback on bugs across active product releases and contribute to the development of knowledge base articles and reusable scripts for recurring issues.
* Actively contribute to team knowledge sharing, fostering a culture of learning and collaboration.
* Mentor and support team members, promoting skill development and knowledge transfer.
* Exhibit a strong commitment to understanding both the technical and business aspects of customer challenges, driving impactful solutions.
* Ensure all activities are performed in compliance with HealthEdge policies and procedures, particularly those related to the handling of PHI and PII.
* Participate in a rotational 24x7 on-call support schedule to provide timely assistance to clients.

INDIA specific:
  
  

* May require early morning or evening shifts (India time) to overlap with US teams. Typically, late-night shifts are not expected.

Additional Role-Specific Competencies:
  
  

* Mentors junior engineers and contributes to onboarding and training.
* Leads cross-functional initiatives to address recurring or systemic issues.
* Champions knowledge sharing by creating new resources and teaching sessions.
* Identifies and mitigates resistance to change, guiding teams through transitions.
* Drives initiatives to address systemic issues and contributes to strategic improvements.

What you bring:
  
  
Education & Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.
* 5-8 years of experience in supporting mission-critical, multi-tiered enterprise applications.
* Hands-on experience in analysis, maintenance, support, implementation, and testing of software systems using Java, J2EE, and internet technologies.
* Domain knowledge in healthcare or US health insurance is preferred.

Technical Proficiency:
  
  

* Strong knowledge of Java-based applications, including Java 11+ code, analyzing stack traces, error codes, and performance issues (e.g., memory leaks, thread contention, slow SQL queries).
* Proficient in web technologies and middleware such as WebLogic/WebSphere.
* Experience with Linux and Windows operating systems- comfortable on a Linux server and familiarity with command lines
* Expertise in relational databases (preferably Oracle), with the ability to understand schemas, write and debug complex SQL queries.
* Hands-on experience with monitoring and analysis tools such as Splunk, ELK Stack, and AppDynamics.
* Experience with SOAP and REST-based web services.
* Skilled in log analysis using tools like grep, with familiarity in structured (JSON, XML) and unstructured log formats.
* Foundational experience in troubleshooting and analyzing Bash scripts.
* Root cause analysis across distributed systems including microservices, APIs, and message queues.
* Experience with writing documentation, creating best practices and standard operating procedures.
* Mentoring/training new support engineers in product knowledge, problems analysis, communication, and technical skills

Preferred:
  
  

* Understanding or experience in:
* Apache Tomcat
* PostgreSQL
* React JS & Spring Boot
* Business & Analytical Skills:
* Strong critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to engage with US/UK customers and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience creating runbooks and knowledge base articles to document root cause analyses and standard procedures.
* Soft Skills & Work Environment:
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to diverse audiences.

title: Flexcube EOD Support
description:
Title : Flexcube EOD Support

Location : Offshore India-Bangalore

Duration : 7 Months

Description:

The objective of this engagement is to provide Level 0 and Level 1 production support services for the Oracle FLEXCUBE Core Banking platform and its integrated ecosystem at Mashreq Bank. The service provider will ensure operational stability, timely resolution of incidents and service requests, support audits, and execution of recurring operational tasks in alignment with Mashreq’s IT governance framework.

The provider shall deliver the following activities as part of L0/L1 support in all regions where Mashreq has implemented Oracle FLEXCUBE:

The provider shall deliver the following activities, with priority on EOD/BOD execution and related processes:

EOD/BOD Monitoring and Execution Support

* Monitor, track, and support EOD/BOD batch cycles across environments.
* Validate successful completion of all scheduled jobs and identify any failures or delays.
* Perform sanity checks post-EOD/BOD to ensure system readiness for business operations.
* Coordinate with upstream/downstream systems to ensure data consistency and cycle completion.

Incident and Alert Management (EOD Priority)

* Monitor and acknowledge alerts, incidents, and service requests raised through Mashreq’s ticketing system.
* Provide first-level analysis and resolution for EOD-related failures and recurring issues using SOPs and knowledge base.
* Take ownership of resolution for P5 (low-priority) incidents, ensuring timely closure within agreed SLAs and proper documentation of fixes or workarounds.
* Escalate unresolved incidents (P1–P4 or complex cases) to L2/L3 with complete diagnostic details (logs, batch IDs, error codes, transaction references).
* Ensure priority handling of EOD-critical issues to minimize business impact.

Operational Support During EOD Window

* Provide active support coverage during extended hours aligned with EOD/BOD cycles and global market timings.
* Maintain real-time communication with stakeholders on EOD progress, delays, and recovery actions.
* Execute controlled interventions such as job restarts, parameter validations, and minor configuration adjustments where applicable.

Post-EOD Validation and Reporting

* Perform reconciliation and system health checks post cycle completion.
* Confirm availability of reports, balances, and downstream feeds.
* Provide EOD status updates and closure confirmation to stakeholders.

Deliverables

Successful and SLA-compliant execution of EOD/BOD cycles across all regions.

Timely resolution of incidents, including end-to-end ownership and closure of P5 incidents.

Daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting on:

EOD execution status

Incident volumes and trends (including P5 resolution performance)

SLA adherence

Required Skills and Knowledge

To be effective in this role, the team need a mix of technical, functional and soft skills.

Good understanding of banking operations (retail, corporate, Islamic, trade modules in FLEXCUBE) and EOD/BOD processing.

Technical proficiency in Oracle SQL, Unix/Linux commands, log analysis, and file handling.

Familiarity with middleware components (e.g., WebLogic, MQ, OHS) and system integrations.

Working knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management).

Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.

Awareness of audit, compliance, and regulatory standards applicable to banking operations.

Support Shift Timing

24x7 or as agreed operating model with shift handovers.

Support coverage to align with Mashreq’s business hours and extended hours for EOD/BOD cycles and global market timings.

Experience- 3-8 years

title: Support Engineer
description:
**About Signeasy**

**Contracts run businesses. We're unlocking the intelligence inside them.**

Signeasy began 16 years ago with a simple idea: signing should be easy. That idea helped the world go paperless. But signatures were only the beginning.

Today, the real problem isn't signing contracts. It's what happens after. In most companies, contracts sit scattered across inboxes, shared drives, CLMs, ERPs, and filing systems. They're static, forgotten, and underused, yet they quietly define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. We believe contracts are one of the most powerful and most overlooked sources of truth in a business.

2025 changed everything. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we began turning them into living, searchable, and intelligent systems of record. We shipped more than 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and were featured at Apple's WWDC, all while building the foundation for what comes next.

2026 is our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we're going to market with an AI-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software.

This is the moment, and this is the team building it. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, read on.

**Your role**

As our Support Engineer, you'll be part of the Customer Support team and the technical voice of Signeasy for our customers. You'll resolve the issues that need more than a help article: API errors, integration failures, SSO setups, mobile app, and tricky account problems. You'll handle tickets end to end and get on calls with our enterprise and API customers when a conversation works better than an email thread.

You'll be the bridge between customers and our engineering team. When something is broken, you'll reproduce it, find the root cause where you can, and hand engineering a clean, well-documented ticket. When something is confusing, you'll fix it at the source with better docs, macros, and product feedback.

If you enjoy digging into logs, love the moment a stubborn issue finally clicks, and care about leaving every customer better off than you found them, you'll find a lot to love here.

**What you'll do**

**Ticket resolution**

* Own tickets across email, chat, and phone, from first response to resolution, within our support SLAs
* Take escalations from the frontline team and resolve complex issues across our web app, iOS and Android apps, eSign API, and Intelligent Contract Management
* Troubleshoot integrations with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, Salesforce, and other tools our customers rely on
* Keep customers informed with clear, honest updates, and manage expectations on timelines and workarounds

**Enterprise and API customers**

* Join calls with enterprise and API customers to debug live issues, walk through setups, and answer technical questions
* Help developers integrate our eSign API: review their requests, read error responses, and point them to best practices
* Support admins with account configuration, SSO/SAML, user management, and compliance-related questions

**Debugging and escalation to engineering**

* Reproduce issues across platforms, and investigate using logs, HAR files, browser dev tools, API tools such as Postman, and SQL queries
* Separate configuration issues from real bugs, and file well-documented Jira tickets with steps to reproduce, impact, and customer context
* Follow escalations through to closure and close the loop with the customer

**Knowledge and product feedback**

* Write and update help center articles, internal runbooks, and Zendesk macros so the next customer or teammate solves it faster
* Spot recurring issues and trends, and share them with Product and Engineering to improve the product
* Respond to app store reviews that need a technical answer

**AI and automation**

* Use AI tools to investigate issues, draft responses, and summarize ticket trends
* Build simple scripts, automations, and templates that cut repetitive work for the support team

**Who you are**

We're looking for someone technical, curious, and customer-first: a problem solver who takes ownership and doesn't let an issue go cold.

* 3 to 4 years of experience in technical or product support for a B2B SaaS product
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, and JSON, with hands-on experience using Postman or similar tools
* Comfort reading logs, analyzing HAR files, and using browser developer tools
* Experience troubleshooting web and mobile apps
* Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar helpdesk) and Jira
* Confidence leading customer calls, including with technical and enterprise stakeholders
* Strong written and spoken English, with a clear, empathetic, and crisp communication style
* Self-driven, organized, and calm under pressure, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with SSO/SAML, OAuth, and webhooks
* Exposure to integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365
* Basic scripting in Python or JavaScript
* Experience with iOS or Android debugging tools

**Why you'll love this role**

This role sits at the center of everything we ship. You'll work with customers of every size, from individual professionals to enterprise and API teams, and partner closely with Product and Engineering to make Signeasy better every week.

Your work will directly shape how customers experience Signeasy: how quickly their problems are solved, how much they trust us, and how the product improves based on what they tell us.

It's a high-ownership role with clear room to grow, into senior support, support operations, solutions engineering, or product, depending on where your interests take you.

**Why work with Signeasy**

Our values make us a TIGER: Trust, Integrity, Growth mindset, Empathy, and Responsibility.

We're a lean, close-knit, and nimble team. We're opinionated but collaborative: we disagree, then commit to a shared decision. We're modern, but we don't follow trends blindly. We're easy to work with, and we believe in having difficult conversations. We ask lots of questions, experiment, and learn fast. And we're deeply empathetic toward our customers, our colleagues, and ourselves.

Our people are our greatest asset. You'll work alongside some of the smartest, most humble people around the world, who come from diverse backgrounds and bring a wide range of experiences. We're a hybrid-friendly organization that values flexibility, with a mix of in-person collaboration at the office and focused work from home.

We are the #SigneasyTribe. Ask us plenty of questions about our culture, so we can both see whether there's a real connection that makes this a great experience for both of us.

**We'd love to hear from you**

Great talent comes from all kinds of paths. If this role speaks to you, please apply, even if you don't match every line on paper. We review every application and will get back to you within a week.

* Hear what it's like to work at Signeasy
* Meet Signeasy's leadership team
* Read our origin story
* Take a peek at Signeasy's culture
* Learn more about growth at Signeasy

Signeasy is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Customer Support Specialist (Bengaluru, India)
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
  
  
As a Customer Support Specialist, you’ll help customers succeed with the Figma product suite, from individual designers to large enterprise teams. You’ll join an experienced, close-knit support team that cares about each other and about doing great work for customers. AI is changing how people design and build, and our products are changing with it. You’ll be among the first to see how customers use what we ship, you’ll learn directly from our Product and Engineering teams, and what you hear from customers will help shape what we build next.
  
  
This is a full-time role based in our Bengaluru office.
  
  
**What you’ll do at Figma:**

* Resolve customer tickets in Zendesk, mostly by email, such as helping a designer get back into a locked account or sorting out who can view and edit a shared file
* Troubleshoot technical issues across the Figma product suite, such as figuring out why a prototype isn’t behaving as expected or why a customer’s AI tool won’t connect to Figma
* Review AI-generated output and credit usage to make fair, consistent calls, such as deciding whether a customer’s AI credit usage matches what they were charged and explaining the outcome clearly

* Facilitate calls with customers when email isn’t enough, such as screen-sharing with an Org admin to walk them through their team’s setup
* Stay current as our products evolve, such as joining a launch session with Product Managers and Engineers, then turning what you learned into a guide or macro for the team
* Work from our Bengaluru office during a schedule that aligns with US business hours

* 2+ years in a customer support role, ideally at a SaaS company
* Hands-on experience with design tools like Figma, and regular use of AI tools in your work
* A knack for technical troubleshooting and explaining complex things simply
* Excellent written English and a warm, human communication style
* Curiosity and a habit of learning new technology on your own

**While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:**

* Professional experience in UX or product design
* Familiarity with AI design or code-generation tools
* Working knowledge of Zendesk
* Background in supporting both self-serve and enterprise customers

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status

description:

Full time
  
  
**Type Of Hire**
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
  
  
**Windows Administration with Patching - Bigfix Change Coordinator & Implementation Analyst (2-5 Years) - Bangalore**
**Job Summary**
The Windows Change Coordinator and Implementation Analyst is responsible for coordinating enterprise Windows Server patching activities, vulnerability remediation, change management, compliance reporting, and operational governance across the FIS infrastructure environment. This role serves as a key coordination point for monthly and emergency patching cycles, implementation tracking, stakeholder communication, reporting, and audit support, while ensuring alignment with ITIL processes and organizational compliance standards.
  
  
The position requires close collaboration with Windows Server administrators, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, Lines of Business, and change management teams to ensure patching activities are planned, implemented, validated, and documented effectively.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Change Coordination & Implementation
  
  

* Coordinate monthly and emergency Windows Server patch implementation activities across the enterprise environment
* Plan patching schedules and maintain implementation calendars to support operational readiness
* Create, track, and manage change requests in accordance with approved change management procedures
* Coordinate outage windows, bridge calls, approvals, and implementation tasks with relevant teams
* Provide timely status updates throughout patch implementation windows
* Track patch implementation outcomes, including successful completions, failures, cancellations, and remediation actions
* Ensure implementation documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant with governance requirements

Patching Operations Support
  
  

* Support enterprise Windows Server patching activities and assist with implementation coordination
* Coordinate with infrastructure and application teams to confirm patch readiness and validation requirements
* Monitor implementation progress and escalate risks, blockers, or delays as required
* Support post-patch validation activities, including operational health checks and follow-up actions
* Maintain accurate patching schedules, implementation trackers, and server inventory details

Vulnerability & Compliance Management
  
  

* Support vulnerability remediation by coordinating patch deployment using approved patch baselines
* Track vulnerability remediation progress, compliance status, and related operational metrics
* Assist in maintaining enterprise patch compliance targets and remediation timelines
* Prepare compliance reports and leadership dashboards to support operational reviews
* Monitor exception management activities and track remediation actions to closure

Reporting & Analytics
  
  

* Develop and maintain operational reports using Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools
* Create dashboards, charts, and presentations for leadership and operational review meetings
* Analyze patching trends, compliance performance, and implementation effectiveness
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and executive-level status reports with clear insights and action items
* Support audit reporting, governance reviews, and evidence collection activities

Stakeholder Communication
  
  

* Manage communications with application owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams
* Provide implementation notifications, progress updates, completion summaries, and follow-up communications
* Facilitate effective communication during patch windows, bridge calls, and incident situations
* Support leadership reviews, operational meetings, and stakeholder discussions with accurate updates

Service Management & Governance
  
  

* Ensure adherence to ITIL-based service management and operational governance processes
* Support incident, problem, and change management processes, including documentation and follow-up
* Maintain accurate implementation records, operational documentation, and audit evidence
* Assist with operational risk assessments, exception reviews, and governance-related follow-up actions

Server Onboarding & Service Enablement
  
  

* Coordinate the onboarding of new servers into the CVPI patching service
* Validate patch readiness, tooling availability, ownership details, and inventory alignment
* Coordinate onboarding requests with application owners and infrastructure teams to ensure service readiness
* Support lifecycle management activities related to patching services and operational support

Automation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support patch automation initiatives and continuous improvement opportunities
* Assist with automated reporting, data collection, and operational tracking activities
* Identify process improvement opportunities to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve reporting accuracy
* Support BigFix, and related patch management platforms where applicable

**Experience**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 2–5 years of experience in IT services, infrastructure support, or enterprise operations environments
* Minimum 2 years of experience working with ITIL processes, service management practices, vulnerability management, and patch management activities

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including~



* VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
* Pivot Tables
* Charts and Dashboards
* Data Analysis and Reporting
* Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent documentation, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide clear operational updates
* Basic understanding of Windows Server operating systems, distributions, and version management
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes and service management governance
* Experience using change management, service delivery, and operational tracking tools
* Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, implementation activities, timelines, and priorities effectively

**Preferred Skills**

* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow or similar IT service management platforms
* Experience in change management, project coordination, or service management functions
* Exposure to Windows Server administration and enterprise infrastructure support
* Knowledge of vulnerability management, compliance tracking, and remediation processes
* Experience supporting enterprise patch management processes and implementation governance
* Understanding of automation tools, operational reporting platforms, and process improvement methods

**Preferred Certifications**

description:
**Position Type**
Full time
  
  
**Type Of Hire**
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
  
  
**Job Description**
**Systems Administrator II or Senior / Unix Change Coordinator & Implementation Analyst**
**Job Summary**
The Unix Change Coordinator and Implementation Analyst is responsible for coordinating enterprise Unix/Linux patching activities, vulnerability remediation, change management, compliance reporting, and operational governance across the FIS infrastructure environment. This role serves as a key coordination point for monthly and emergency patching cycles, implementation tracking, stakeholder communication, reporting, and audit support, while ensuring alignment with ITIL processes and organizational compliance standards.
  
  
The position requires close collaboration with Unix administrators, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, Lines of Business, and change management teams to ensure patching activities are planned, implemented, validated, and documented effectively.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Change Coordination & Implementation
  
  

* Coordinate monthly and emergency Unix/Linux patch implementation activities across the enterprise environment
* Plan patching schedules and maintain implementation calendars to support operational readiness
* Create, track, and manage change requests in accordance with approved change management procedures
* Coordinate outage windows, bridge calls, approvals, and implementation tasks with relevant teams
* Provide timely status updates throughout patch implementation windows
* Track patch implementation outcomes, including successful completions, failures, cancellations, and remediation actions
* Ensure implementation documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant with governance requirements

Patching Operations Support
  
  

* Support enterprise Unix/Linux patching activities and assist with implementation coordination
* Coordinate with infrastructure and application teams to confirm patch readiness and validation requirements
* Monitor implementation progress and escalate risks, blockers, or delays as required
* Support post-patch validation activities, including operational health checks and follow-up actions
* Maintain accurate patching schedules, implementation trackers, and server inventory details

Vulnerability & Compliance Management
  
  

* Support vulnerability remediation by coordinating patch deployment using approved patch baselines
* Track vulnerability remediation progress, compliance status, and related operational metrics
* Assist in maintaining enterprise patch compliance targets and remediation timelines
* Prepare compliance reports and leadership dashboards to support operational reviews
* Monitor exception management activities and track remediation actions to closure

Reporting & Analytics
  
  

* Develop and maintain operational reports using Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools
* Create dashboards, charts, and presentations for leadership and operational review meetings
* Analyze patching trends, compliance performance, and implementation effectiveness
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and executive-level status reports with clear insights and action items
* Support audit reporting, governance reviews, and evidence collection activities

Stakeholder Communication
  
  

* Manage communications with application owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams
* Provide implementation notifications, progress updates, completion summaries, and follow-up communications
* Facilitate effective communication during patch windows, bridge calls, and incident situations
* Support leadership reviews, operational meetings, and stakeholder discussions with accurate updates

Service Management & Governance
  
  

* Ensure adherence to ITIL-based service management and operational governance processes
* Support incident, problem, and change management processes, including documentation and follow-up
* Maintain accurate implementation records, operational documentation, and audit evidence
* Assist with operational risk assessments, exception reviews, and governance-related follow-up actions

Server Onboarding & Service Enablement
  
  

* Coordinate the onboarding of new servers into the CVPI patching service
* Validate patch readiness, tooling availability, ownership details, and inventory alignment
* Coordinate onboarding requests with application owners and infrastructure teams to ensure service readiness
* Support lifecycle management activities related to patching services and operational support

Automation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support patch automation initiatives and continuous improvement opportunities
* Assist with automated reporting, data collection, and operational tracking activities
* Identify process improvement opportunities to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve reporting accuracy
* Support BigFix, Red Hat Satellite, and related patch management platforms where applicable

**Experience**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 5–10 years of experience in IT services, infrastructure support, or enterprise operations environments
* Minimum 2 years of experience working with ITIL processes, service management practices, vulnerability management, and patch management activities

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including~

+ VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
+ Pivot Tables
+ Charts and Dashboards
+ Data Analysis and Reporting

* Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent documentation, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide clear operational updates
* Basic understanding of Unix/Linux operating systems, distributions, and version management
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes and service management governance
* Experience using change management, service delivery, and operational tracking tools
* Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, implementation activities, timelines, and priorities effectively

**Preferred Skills**

* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow or similar IT service management platforms
* Experience in change management, project coordination, or service management functions
* Exposure to Unix/Linux system administration and enterprise infrastructure support
* Knowledge of vulnerability management, compliance tracking, and remediation processes
* Experience supporting enterprise patch management processes and implementation governance
* Understanding of automation tools, operational reporting platforms, and process improvement methods

**Preferred Certifications**

* ITIL Foundation Certification
* Linux/Unix certifications are an added advantage

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
  
  
**Sourcing Model**
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: Founding Support Engineer
description: About TrueFoundryEvery production AI system whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions needs the same foundational infrastructure.A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.That infrastructure layer is being built right now.We are looking for a Founding Support Engineer to join the team.The Problem We're SolvingCompanies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct-tape together a few API calls and call it production-ready.You Need a Control Plane That HandlesIntelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logicCentralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controlsAgent orchestration with governance and guardrailsA unified compute layer to run self-hosted models, custom tools, and agentsAI Gateway is the control plane five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.About RoleAs a Support Engineer, you are the person these teams call when their production AI stack hits a wall. You are not answering how-to tickets for a SaaS tool. You are debugging MCP proxy scaling issues, RBAC and SSO configs, Gateway sizing, and guardrail behavior for engineering teams at some of the most sophisticated companies in the world, across finance, healthcare, retail, and more. Few support roles anywhere put you this close to how enterprise AI actually gets built and run.What You Will DoBe the first and most trusted line of response when enterprise customers hit issues in production, across severities from routine questions to P0 incidents.Get hands-on with real infrastructure problems, Gateway configuration, MCP proxy scaling, RBAC and SSO, guardrails, sizing, not surface-level troubleshooting.Own tickets to actual resolution, not just closure, and know the difference.Triage and file issues to engineering with clean, reproducible detail when a fix needs to go deeper than support.Build and contribute to the internal knowledge base and runbooks, so the next ticket like this one gets solved faster.Work inside the escalation and priority process, and hold the line on incident response coverage.What Success Looks LikeResponsiveness and resolution: first response time against SLA tiered by severity (P0 through P3), time to resolution by severity, and keeping the backlog of aging tickets under control.Quality of resolution: high first contact resolution rate, low reopen rate, strong CSAT on resolved tickets, and an escalation rate that reflects real complexity rather than gaps in troubleshooting.Technical depth: a track record of finding actual root cause on infra issues rather than patching symptoms, clean and reproducible bug reports handed to engineering, and real contributions to the knowledge base and runbooks.Team and process health: consistent adherence to the escalation and tiering process, reliable on-call and incident coverage, and documentation that holds up under peer review.Who We're Looking ForSomeone who can read logs, reason about distributed systems, and stay calm inside a live incident. Comfortable with Kubernetes and at least one major cloud. Some exposure to LLMs, agents, or ML pipelines in production is a strong plus, you will pick up the rest fast if the fundamentals are there. Clear written communication matters as much as technical chops, since a lot of trust is built through how you write up a ticket.Traits we are looking for: Ownership, ability to execute, hustle and think out of the box, data driven decision making, be comfortable with more unknowns than knowns.Perks of Working at TrueFoundryJoin a fast-growing Series A, Bay Area-based startup building cutting-edge AI infrastructure.Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.Flexible hybrid work, 3 days a week in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday), with flexibility around the schedule.Lunch and snacks are on us whenever you come into the office.Work from another TrueFoundry office for up to 3 months each year, whether that's our London or Bay Area office, if you'd like a change of scenery.

title: IT Administrator
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Industry: Technology, Information and Internet

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

  

Experience: 6+ yrs  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India  
Job Type: Full-time

We are looking for an experienced **Corporate IT & Workplace Technology Manager** to own end-to-end IT operations for a growing technology organisation.

This is a hands-on, single-owner domain expert role responsible for corporate IT infrastructure, endpoint management, IT asset lifecycle, workplace technology, networking, identity and access management, and IT compliance. The ideal candidate will be comfortable independently managing the entire IT environment while building secure, reliable, and scalable systems for a growing workforce.

**Requirements**
----------------

### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own end-to-end corporate IT operations for the organisation and Bengaluru office.
* Manage **MacBook, Windows devices, peripherals, and other IT hardware** across the complete asset lifecycle.
* Lead hardware procurement, reseller negotiations, AMC management, warranty coordination, buybacks, refresh cycles, and replacements.
* Implement and manage **zero-touch MDM and endpoint security** across macOS and Windows environments.
* Manage endpoint encryption, patching, EDR, security policies, compliance controls, and remote-wipe capabilities.
* Maintain accurate IT asset records from **procurement through disposal**, ensuring zero untracked devices.
* Manage ITAM/ITSM platforms and maintain accurate asset, service, and support documentation.
* Own corporate office networking, including Wi-Fi, VLANs, 802.1X/RADIUS, guest networks, firewalls, and ISP connectivity.
* Ensure network reliability through appropriate redundancy, monitoring, troubleshooting, and vendor coordination.
* Manage conference-room and town-hall AV infrastructure to ensure reliable meeting and event experiences.
* Administer **Google Workspace, SSO, SAML, user provisioning, and access management**.
* Manage joiner, mover, and leaver processes and conduct periodic access reviews.
* Maintain SaaS application inventory, ownership, licensing, renewals, and technology spend.
* Support **SOC 2 and ISO 27001** compliance requirements, including endpoint evidence, access reviews, policies, and audit documentation.
* Ensure backups are configured, monitored, and periodically tested.
* Establish and maintain IT policies, processes, documentation, and operational standards.
* Coordinate with vendors, technology partners, security teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve IT reliability, security, automation, employee experience, and operational efficiency.
* Monitor technology costs and identify opportunities for vendor and SaaS optimisation.
* Troubleshoot critical infrastructure, endpoint, networking, identity, and workplace technology issues.
* Ensure the IT environment remains secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with business requirements.

### **WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT**

* **6–11 years of experience** in corporate IT, IT operations, workplace technology, or a related field.
* At least **3 years of experience independently owning an IT site, office, or device fleet end to end**.
* Strong hands-on experience managing corporate IT environments in a product company or technology startup.
* Production experience with MDM platforms such as **Jamf, Kandji, Mosyle, Hexnode, or Microsoft Intune**.
* Strong practical experience managing enterprise networks using technologies such as **Ubiquiti UniFi, Meraki, Aruba, or Ruckus**.
* Experience administering ITAM or ITSM platforms such as **Snipe-IT, Freshservice, Jira Service Management, or ServiceNow**.
* Hands-on experience with conference-room and workplace AV solutions such as **Zoom Rooms, Google Meet hardware, Neat, Poly, Logitech, or Crestron**.
* Strong understanding of endpoint security, device encryption, patch management, EDR, remote management, and security controls.
* Experience managing **Google Workspace, SSO, SAML, identity lifecycle, and access reviews**.
* Working knowledge of **SOC 2, ISO 27001**, audit evidence, IT controls, and compliance requirements.
* Strong vendor management, procurement, negotiation, and IT budget-management skills.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently as the primary IT owner.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced **product/startup environment** rather than a traditional IT services or pure GCC support setup.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, security, and operational reliability.
* Willingness to work **on-site in Bengaluru** and take complete ownership of the corporate IT environment.

Job Title: Service Desk Operations & Governance SME  
Position: Associate Consultant
  
Experience: 6+ Years  
Category: Software Development/ Engineering  
Main location: Bangalore  
Job Code: J0826-2154  
Employment Type: Full Time  
  
Job Description:
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Service Desk professional with strong operational and ITIL expertise to take ownership of the day-to-day operational governance of a multilingual Service Desk environment.  
The role will be responsible for ensuring that Service Desk operations are structured, measurable, governed and continuously improved. The individual will analyse operational performance, identify recurring issues and service gaps, drive corrective actions, ensure adherence to agreed processes and coordinate with L2/L3 teams to improve resolution outcomes.  
The role is not limited to managing people or monitoring queues. The successful candidate will act as a Service Desk subject-matter expert and operational governance owner, bringing structure, discipline and analytical insight into the operation.  
The role will work closely with the Service Delivery Manager, Service Desk Leads, L2/L3 resolver teams, application teams, infrastructure teams, workplace/EUS teams, vendors and client stakeholders.  
Key Responsibilities:  
  
1. Service Desk Operational Governance  

* Own the day-to-day operational governance of the Service Desk.
* Establish and maintain operational routines covering:

o Daily operational review  
o SLA performance  
o Backlog  
o Aging tickets  
o Priority incidents  
o Reassignments  
o Escalations  
o Abandoned/unanswered calls  
o Ticket quality  
o Customer feedback  

* Ensure operational teams follow agreed processes, SOPs and ITIL practices.
* Identify deviations from the operating model and drive corrective actions.
* Ensure appropriate ownership and accountability across the Service Desk.
* Maintain operational readiness for changes, new services and project transitions.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
2. Performance & Data Analysis  
This should be one of the core responsibilities of the role.  

* Analyse Service Desk performance trends and identify underlying causes.
* Monitor and interpret:

o SLA achievement  
o Response and resolution performance  
o Ticket volumes  
o Backlog  
o Aging  
o Reopen rates  
o First Contact Resolution  
o Escalation rates  
o Call abandonment  
o Customer satisfaction  
o Productivity  
o Quality scores  

* Identify trends rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Produce meaningful operational insights and recommendations.
* Identify recurring operational issues and translate them into improvement initiatives.
* Maintain dashboards and management reports.
* Prepare inputs for weekly/monthly service reviews.
* Highlight risks and emerging issues to the SDM before they become escalations.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
3. Ticket Hygiene & Quality Management  

* Drive improvement in Service Desk ticket quality and documentation.
* Ensure tickets contain appropriate:

o Categorisation  
o Prioritisation  
o User/business impact  
o Troubleshooting performed  
o Worklogs  
o Resolution details  
o Knowledge references  
o Closure information  

* Perform regular ticket sampling and quality audits.
* Identify recurring quality issues by agent/team/process.
* Work with Team Leads to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure tickets are progressed appropriately and do not remain unnecessarily in queues.
* Identify tickets requiring escalation and ensure timely handover to L2/L3.
* Monitor tickets approaching SLA breach and ensure proactive intervention.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
4. Incident, Problem & Escalation Management  

* Provide operational oversight of Major/P1/P2 incidents from the Service Desk perspective.
* Ensure correct prioritisation and escalation based on business impact.
* Support Major Incident Management and ensure appropriate Service Desk participation.
* Identify recurring incidents and candidates for Problem Management.
* Analyse repeat incidents and identify opportunities for permanent resolution.
* Work with L2/L3 resolver groups to drive recurring-problem reduction.
* Track outstanding actions from major incidents and problem investigations.
* Ensure lessons learned are converted into process, knowledge or technical improvements.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
5. Cross-Functional Coordination  
Act as the operational bridge between Service Desk and resolver teams.  

* Coordinate with L2/L3 Infrastructure, Applications, EUS, IAM, Network, Cloud and other support teams.
* Identify bottlenecks in the incident/request resolution lifecycle.
* Challenge unnecessary ticket transfers and ownership gaps.
* Ensure clear escalation paths are followed.
* Drive resolution of aged or stuck tickets across resolver groups.
* Identify recurring dependency issues between Service Desk and other support towers.
* Work with application and infrastructure SMEs to improve knowledge available to the Service Desk.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
6. Process & Continual Service Improvement  

* Identify opportunities to streamline Service Desk processes.
* Review existing workflows and identify unnecessary manual steps.
* Drive continual improvement initiatives around:

o Incident management  
o Request fulfilment  
o Knowledge management  
o Escalation  
o Ticket routing  
o Categorisation  
o Automation  
o Self-service  
o Monitoring integration  

* Identify opportunities for automation and shift-left.
* Improve First Contact Resolution through better knowledge, tooling and training.
* Maintain and improve Service Desk SOPs and operational documentation.
* Support implementation of ITIL-aligned practices.
* Ensure improvements are measurable and demonstrate operational/business benefit.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
7. Knowledge Management  

* Ensure knowledge articles are available and usable by Service Desk agents.
* Identify knowledge gaps from ticket trends and recurring incidents.
* Work with L2/L3 teams to convert technical resolutions into Service Desk knowledge.
* Review the quality and usefulness of existing knowledge articles.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge Management and shift-left practices.
* Identify opportunities for self-service and automation based on recurring requests.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
8. Team Coaching & Operational Enablement  
The role should not replace the Team Leads, but should provide SME-level direction and coaching.  

* Coach Team Leads and senior analysts on ITIL processes and operational practices.
* Support agents in improving troubleshooting and ticket-handling quality.
* Identify capability gaps based on operational data.
* Recommend targeted training and coaching.
* Conduct periodic knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Support onboarding of new Service Desk resources.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
9. Client & Stakeholder Support  
The person will have stakeholder interaction, but the SDM remains the primary client/account owner.  

* Provide operational inputs for client service reviews.
* Prepare factual analysis and recommendations for the SDM.
* Participate in operational governance meetings.
* Support service-related escalations.
* Provide timely updates on operational risks and improvement actions.
* Translate operational data into meaningful business-level insights.
* Support the SDM in preparing service improvement proposals and operational roadmaps.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
10. Governance & Compliance  

* Ensure adherence to agreed governance frameworks and contractual processes.
* Maintain operational evidence required for audits and governance reviews.
* Ensure compliance with ITIL, security and organisational processes.
* Track actions, risks, issues and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain Service Desk operational documentation and control mechanisms.
* Support internal and client audits where required.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
11. Key Deliverables / KPIs  
I would make the role accountable for outcomes, rather than just activities.  
Area Expected Outcome  
SLA Consistent SLA achievement and early intervention on breaches  
Backlog Controlled and continuously improving backlog  
Ticket Aging Reduction of aged/stagnant tickets  
Ticket Quality Improved ticket hygiene and documentation  
FCR Continuous improvement in First Contact Resolution  
CSAT Improvement in customer experience  
Escalations Reduction in avoidable escalations  
Repeat Incidents Identification and reduction of recurring issues  
Quality Consistent quality audit performance  
Process Compliance High adherence to agreed ITIL processes  
Knowledge Increased usage and quality of knowledge articles  
Automation Identification and delivery of automation opportunities  
Continual Improvement Measurable improvement initiatives delivered  
Governance Accurate and timely operational reporting  
  
Mandatory Skills:  

* 6+ years of Service Desk / IT Operations experience, with significant experience in senior/SME/leadership roles.
* Strong experience managing large or complex Service Desk operations.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Incident, Request, Problem, Change and Knowledge Management.
* Experience with SLA/KPI management and operational governance.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Demonstrated experience in root-cause analysis and recurring-issue reduction.
* Strong understanding of Service Desk ticket lifecycle and ITSM practices.
* Experience working with L2/L3 resolver teams.
* Experience managing operational escalations.
* Experience in continual service improvement.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience working in a multi-team / multi-vendor IT environment.

Preferred Skills :
  

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* ITIL Managing Professional modules would be an advantage.
* Experience with TopDesk, ServiceNow, BMC Remedy or similar ITSM platforms.
* Experience with multilingual Service Desk operations.
* Experience with Service Desk transformation, automation and shift-left initiatives.
* Experience with Microsoft technologies / Workplace / EUS environments.
* Experience in outsourced IT service delivery / managed services

description:

The Mobile Device Management (MDM) Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing and supporting customer mobile device environments using the NinjaOne platform under the guidance of the MDM Team Lead. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned incidents and service requests, maintaining ownership through resolution while ensuring compliance with contracted SLAs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is customer focused, technically skilled and thrives in a fast paced operations environment. This position requires shift flexibility, including participation in rotating on call schedules and the ability to work varying shifts as business needs evolve.
  
  
The MDM Engineer will regularly collaborate with customers, peers, vendors and leadership through phone, email, chat, video conferencing and ticketing systems such as ServiceNow to ensure timely and effective issue resolution.

* Monitor and manage enrolled mobile devices across iOS, Android and Windows platforms using the NinjaOne MDM platform.

* Administer device configuration profiles, security policies and compliance baselines within NinjaOne to enforce organizational standards across managed endpoints.
* Manage application deployment, updates and removal across mobile device fleets using NinjaOne software management capabilities.
* Support device lifecycle activities including enrollment, onboarding, offboarding and remote wipe for lost or decommissioned devices.
* Communicate effectively with customers, peers, management and cross functional engineering teams regarding incidents, outages and change activities.

* Understanding of mobile security concepts including device encryption, certificate based authentication, passcode enforcement and data loss prevention policies.

* Strong customer service and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast paced operations environment.

* Familiarity with ITIL based incident, problem and change management processes.
* Experience using ServiceNow or similar ticketing platforms.
* Experience with additional MDM platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf or VMware Workspace ONE.
* Familiarity with NinjaOne RMM capabilities including scripting, automation and alerting as they complement MDM operations.
* Experience with PowerShell or scripting tools for automating device management tasks and reporting.
* Relevant certifications such as NinjaOne certifications, CompTIA Mobile App Security or equivalent vendor credentials.

* Adaptability and flexibility

***Job Family Definition:***

The job family spans across multiple engineering disciplines. Work consists of designing, developing, analyzing, troubleshooting and debugging systems, software and solutions for research and/or research development of product, services, and solutions for HPE’s portfolio. Requires a broad knowledge and application of engineering disciplines, methodologies and tools.

Job Family Definition for Executive Levels only: Directs and manages a diverse team of engineering professionals performing research, development, design and/or implementation of products, services, solutions for the company’s portfolio. Responsible for creating and communicating technical strategy within the organization and/or across the function.

***Management Level Definition:***

Contributes to assignments of limited scope by applying technical concepts and theoretical knowledge acquired through specialized training, education, or previous experience. Acts as team member by providing information, analysis and recommendations in support of team efforts. Exercises independent judgment within defined parameters.

* Designs portions of engineering solutions utilizing multiple engineering disciplines for products, systems, software, and solutions based on established engineering principles and in accordance with provided specifications and requirements
* Implements established test plans for existing designs, including validation of mechanical, electrical, software, and other engineering specifications and requirements.
* Develops understanding of and relationship with internal and outsourced development partners on engineering design and development.
* Participates as a member of project team of other engineers and internal and outsourced development partners to develop reliable, cost effective and high quality solutions for low to moderately- complex products.

**What you need to bring:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or other Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.

title: Data Center Technician III
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware and experience with networking protocols.
* Experience with assembly of mechanical or electrical systems, or performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
* Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.
* Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in maintenance and monitoring of server systems.
* 2 years of experience in troubleshooting hardware and network issues using Linux tools (e.g., LPIC-1, CCNA).
* Proven experience in maintenance of server and storage systems.
* Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.

**About The Job**
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.
  
  
As a Data Center Technician for our Google Cloud region, your duties range from the physical deployment of technology to working closely with various stakeholders. You will ensure that our goals, missions and projects are successfully delivered, and, more importantly, that they are repeatable across our global array of data centers. A typical day involves movement and installation of equipment, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you will work with computer technology to ensure quality and reliability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, test, troubleshoot, and repair advanced server hardware and server software.
* Manage and set up complex network components, including routers, bridges, and switches.
* Lead or contribute to local installation projects, create contingency plans, and collaborate with stakeholders.
* Ensure mission goals and deployments are reliably executed and repeatable across Google's global data center network.
* Manage equipment movement and installation to uphold data center quality and operational uptime.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. You’ll also serve as an escalation resource for more complex technical issues and work closely with the Helpdesk, Networking, Cybersecurity, and other teams to keep our technology reliable, secure, and effective.

We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, documents their work, and enjoys solving problems. CTI employees are known as customer-focused problem-solvers who can get the job done and do it with a great attitude.

***What are your responsibilities?***

These responsibilities give an idea not a full picture of what you’ll do, as we work to embrace and capitalize on our employees’ strengths:

* **Systems Administration:** Maintain, monitor, troubleshoot, and support company systems, infrastructure, and business technology services.
* **Backend Systems Management:** Manage and maintain backend systems, servers, and related infrastructure to ensure system stability, availability, and performance.
* **User & Access Administration:** Manage user accounts, permissions, access, and related administrative requests while following established security practices.
* **Escalated Technical Support:** Serve as an escalation point for complex issues that require deeper troubleshooting beyond Level 1 support.
* **System Maintenance:** Assist with system updates, patching, upgrades, deployments, and ongoing lifecycle management.
* **Backup & Recovery Management:** Monitor and manage system and data backups, verify backup completion, troubleshoot backup failures, and assist with data restoration and recovery when needed.
* **Monitoring & Reliability:** Monitor system health, availability, and performance, and respond appropriately to issues to maintain reliable IT services.
* **Security Support:** Work with Cybersecurity and other IT team members to address vulnerabilities, access concerns, and security-related improvements.
* **Troubleshooting & Problem Solving:** Identify root causes, resolve recurring issues, and develop long-term solutions instead of relying solely on temporary fixes.
* **Projects & Improvements:** Participate in technology upgrades, migrations, deployments, and other IT projects.
* **Documentation:** Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles so information can be shared across the IT team.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with Helpdesk, Networking, Cybersecurity, vendors, and business teams to resolve issues and improve the employee technology experience.
* **Other Duties:** Perform other tasks as assigned.

***Will you fit in?***

* Our employees fearlessly embrace the company culture and applicants who merely want to punch in their timecards everyday are not what we are looking for.
* You can work independently with minimal guidance but aren’t afraid to ask the right questions when you need help.
* You are passionate about learning and sharing knowledge with your team to improve the entire team.
* You enjoy troubleshooting and finding better ways to solve recurring problems.
* Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical employees.
* Understand that great IT support is about both technology and customer experience.
* Are organized, dependable, and able to manage multiple priorities.
Are willing to jump in and help wherever needed to support the team.  

***Does experience count?***

* 3+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure support, or a similar IT role.
* Experience administering and supporting enterprise business systems, backend infrastructure, and user environments.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, applications, user access, endpoints, and network connectivity.
* Working knowledge of networking, identity and access management, system security, data backups, recovery procedures, and general infrastructure concepts.
* Experience supporting system updates, patching, maintenance, and technology deployments.
* Experience monitoring and managing system backups and assisting with data restoration and recovery when needed.
* Strong documentation and organizational skills.
* A strong customer service mindset with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of issues through completion.

title: ICT Engineer - Buildings
description:
Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible. The Stantec community unites approximately 32,000 employees working in over 450 locations across 6 continents.

Key Accountabilities:

* Daily electrical design duties of all Building Services requirements. Day to day tasks include 30% to 100% Design Stages for buildings infrastructure and assistance for the Project and multi–Discipline Engineers. Coordination with regional leads.
* The engineer will be responsible for development of Telecom, AV, Security design as per the client needs and requirements.
* As a Technology engineer, it should be expected that the duties will be flexible, providing design assistance for multiple projects.
* Work as a team member to coordinate design projects with professional engineers and other CAD/BIM technicians.
* Utilize customized tools, utilities, and scripts to automate work processes and improve design productivity and efficiency and to comply with the company design standards.

Competencies:

* The Candidate should be an Adept on calculations and Telecom design, specification and selection work for telecom, fire alarm, Audio Visual, Security and CCTV.
* Carry out complete design includes Structural Cabling plans, security, audio-visual plans, layout of IDF/MDF/Demarc rooms, horizontal cabling and fiber backbone one-lines, flow diagrams, sections, elevations, material schedules, Generate Wi-Fi-heat map reports
* Coordinate with project engineers for all electrical/ELV systems requirements, RFI Handling
* Collaborate and coordinate with other disciplines design-changes and model reviews.
* Preparation of design deliverable, tender preparation as per project requirements.
* Ensure proper backup and archiving
* Follow TIA, BICSI, NEC codes, standards and design development procedures.
* Participate in MEP Design model and/or content review for 3D Coordination Meeting
* Firsthand experience of REVIT MEP, BIM360 and NAVISWORKS.

Person Specifications:

* 3 to 8 years of relevant career experience with a Degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Relevant IT skills/computer literate.
* Knowledge of TIA, BICSI, NEC, NEMA, NFPA standards.
* Mission Critical projects experience will be preferred.
* Good command of English (communication and writing skills).
* Experience in Electrical and Fire alarm system is an added advantage.

title: Field Service Specialist
description:
**Overview**
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.
  
  
We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams.
  
  
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you.
  
  
At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact.
  
  
Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery.
  
  
‎
  
  
Position Description
  
  
**Major Tasks**

* Install, maintain, repair and support equipment on all levels (hardware, software and applications)
* Maintain and develop positive relationships with customers
* Utilize relevant databases to input and provide information that will increase effectiveness
* Utilize all available tools such as Service Reports, Spare Part & Service Manuals, ISI Notes, etc
* Assist in the development and maintenance of reference customers
* Assist in Meeting/exceeding sales targets in relation to maintaining high customer satisfaction
* Actively promote and sell Field Service products
* Give active feedback to Sales, Global Product Support and your team/management
* Manage effective available time and resources
* Provide cross-border/district/region support when required
* Positively represent QIAGEN in front of the customer, be a good example!
* Ability to lift ~50lb or 25kgs

Will require work with hazardous substances such as acids and solvents and to work in biological laboratories up to BSL3.
  
  
Position Requirements
  
  

* Technical degree/education in Electronics and reasonable product knowledge within the Life Science industry /markets preferable, Automation experience added advantage
* Preferable minimum of 3-6 years of service and support experience in a comparable position within the after sales service business in the Life Science industry/markets, or equivalent experience maintaining instrumentation
* Proven work experience in developing customer relationships
* Valid driver’s license and Passport and willingness to travel, national and internationally
* Good written and verbal English language communication skills
* Good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work both independently and in a structured working environment
* Willingness to travel for more than 80%.
* Team Player

Personal Requirements
  
  

* Should have strong analytical, problem solving & customer management skills
* Should be willing to learn and pick up information on one own initiative, self-motivated, quick learner and also willing to dissipate and share knowledge
* Self-organized and motivated with the ability to work independently while under guidance from manager.
* Excellent listening, presentation and communication skills at all business levels in both local language and English.

**What We Offer**

* Bonus/Commission
* Local benefits
* Referral Program
* Volunteer Day
* Internal Academy (QIALearn)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Hybrid work (conditional to your role)

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.
  
  
QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

title: Principal IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Overview:**

McDermott requires an IAM Administrator to support our Saviynt Cloud IAM platform. The implementation of Saviynt IAM tool is to ensure an excellent employee onboarding and offboarding experience while supporting our regulatory requirements.

This is a crucial role in the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of identity and access management solutions using the Saviynt platform. The role will partner with various IT and business functions to understand Business Use cases, design workflows and integrations, identify process improvements, access management gaps as well as implement technical solutions within McDermott's Saviynt tenant.

Due to the criticality and partnership needs of the role, the admin should pay attention to accuracy and detail with excellent verbal and written communication.

This position will work as a member of the Global Application Support team and will interface with the Cyber Security Team, various Application subject matter experts, Infrastructure Team and IT Operations.

  

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
  
  
For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

  

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

McDermott is looking to deploy Saviynt as their key IGA solution. The key responsibilities of this position will be:

* Serve as the technical expert for McDermott's Saviynt platform.
* Responsible for development within the Saviynt platform to support business requirements.
* Responsible for onboarding applications, develop, and implement system integrations and connectors, etc.
* Create process and technical reference documentation.
* Conduct periodic certification reviews for critical applications to ensure regulatory compliance.
* Ensure project requirements support the overall IAM/IGA program.
* Innovation through AI capabilities within and outside Saviynt
* Conduct testing to ensure that changes made match requirements gathered from stakeholders.
* Analyze data within Saviynt to provide recommendations to further support the IAM/IGA program.
* Recommend solutions to streamline processes and create overall efficiency of the Saviynt product.
* Manage upgrades, patching and maintenance of the IGA systems and testing deliverables

  

**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Minimum Bachelor’s Degree
* 5+ years of Saviynt Admin hands-on experience.
* Have good knowledge on Saviynt IGA architecture with hands on experience in employee & application onboarding/offboarding, implementing workflows, SOD, certifications, audit reporting etc
* Hands on experience on OOTB Saviynt connectors, Custom JARS and other Integration tools.
* Experience with enterprise directory solutions (Active Directory, MIM, Azure, HR Sources, etc.)
* Familiar with PowerShell Scripts, JSON, SQL
* Overall exposure on Identity & access management of 7- 8 years (Required)
* Awareness of IT Controls (General Controls, SOX, ISO).
* Ability to troubleshoot and fix the issues within team and with Saviynt support team.
* Saviynt Certified IGA Professional (preferred)
* Experience with Cloud version 25 or higher (preferred)
* Exposure with Implementation and/or administration of Saviynt
* Exposure to PAM and Multi-factor Authentication solutions.
* ITIL/ITSM process knowledge.
* Integration with logging, reporting, automation tools
* AI tools exposure.
* Professional MS Office tools.
