title: Manager - SAP Platform Management [T500-30226]
description:
**About Costco Wholesale:**

Costco Wholesale is a multi-billion-dollar global retailer with warehouse club operations in eleven countries. They provide a wide selection of quality merchandise, plus the convenience of specialty departments and exclusive member services, all designed to make shopping a pleasurable experience for their members.

**About Costco Wholesale India:**

At Costco Wholesale India, we foster a collaborative space, working to support Costco Wholesale in developing innovative solutions that improve members’ experiences and make employees’ jobs easier. Our employees play a key role in driving and delivering innovation to establish IT as a core competitive advantage for Costco Wholesale.

**Position:**
Manager - SAP

**Location: Hyderabad.**

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health benefits - medical/dental/vision/hearing aid/pharmacy/behavioral health/employee assistance, health care reimbursement account, dependent

care assistance plan, short-term disability and long-term disability insurance, AD&D insurance, life insurance, 401(k), stock purchase plan to eligible employees.

**Work Schedule:**
Monday - Friday

**Position Summary:**

As a member of the IT Management Team, you are responsible for the management, development, and strategic leadership of your team. This includes overseeing performance, managing deliverables, and ensuring the development and execution of the team’s strategic vision and plan. Your leadership must ensure that all team actions are fully aligned with the larger goals of the company and the IT Division.

The SAP Manager is a senior IT leadership role responsible for managing and evolving Costco’s SAP Platform including Basis, Security, GRC, Change Control, Development and Finance Functional capabilities across both US and EU landscapes. This highly visible position sits at the intersection of IT governance, regulatory compliance, and enterprise security, partnering closely with business stakeholders, IT leadership, and EU counterparts to ensure all SAP ITGC controls are operating effectively and that compliance obligations are met at scale.

As a member of the IT Management team, you will lead a dedicated team, oversee strategic program deliverables, and serve as a key voice in shaping the future-state of SAP risk and governance across Costco’s global operations. You will champion innovation, drive automation, and foster a culture of trust, open communication, and continuous improvement.

As the primary conduit between your employees and upper leadership, your role in communicating and modeling the values and guiding principles of our company culture is of vital importance. All members of IT Management should strive to consciously and consistently foster a culture of engagement, trust, and “open door” communication.

**Job Duties/Essential Functions:**

* **INTEGRITY:**
  When achieving benchmarks and goals, use methods/strategies that are consistent with the Code of Ethics and the Standard of Ethics for Managers and Supervisors. Always leads by example. Appropriately handles employee concerns and follows through to resolution.
* **MEMBER SERVICE:**
  Provides and ensures staff provides an exceptional member experience.
* **MANAGING PERFORMANCE:**
  Coaches and mentors’ employees to provide support and guidance. Has regular open and honest conversations with employees to discuss work performance and career development. Identifies learning opportunities to strengthen employee knowledge, skill, and ability.
* **COMMUNICATION:**
  Regularly shares information with employees via meetings and one-on-one conversations. Successfully navigates difficult conversations with employees, members, and suppliers. Listens, expresses empathy, and adapts to get points across. Addresses issues immediately to ensure a timely resolution and to avoid escalating the situation. Consistently demonstrates business knowledge during interactions with senior management.
* **SELF-MANAGEMENT:**
  Demonstrates sound judgment, taking a partner when necessary. Ability to maintain self-control in the face of hostility or provocation or in intense, hectic situations.
* **INCLUSION**
  : Encourages different approaches and ideas to work and to accomplish goals. Seeks employee input. Takes the time to get to know or reach out to candidates who show potential that may not come forward on their own.
* **COMPLIANCE AND SAFETY:**
  Takes measures to ensure employee and member information is kept confidential and adheres to IS security policy.
* Identifies and champions innovative technology solutions, including automation and predictive analytics, to enhance Cross dock and Return Depot efficiency.
* Maintains business relationships with all levels of Cross dock and Return Depots management, technical teams, and associated vendors.
* Maintains current knowledge of managing large scale, complex projects concurrently, including developing strategies with cross-functional teams across a wide variety of disciplines.
* Maintains budgeting and portfolio finances.
* Travels occasionally based on business needs.
* This is a full-time management/leadership position (45+ hours per week)
* Regular and reliable workplace attendance at your assigned location.

**Ability to operate vehicles, equipment or machinery:**

* Computer, phone, printer, copier, fax.

**Non-Essential Functions:**

* Assists in other areas of the department as necessary
* Assists in other areas of the company as necessary

**Ability to operate vehicles, equipment or machinery:**

* Same as Essential Functions

**Experience, Skills, Education & Licenses/Certifications:**

**Required:**

* 10+ years of experience with SAP Platform & architecture.
* 5+ SAP Security, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC).
* 5+ years of experience with SAP Change Management and transport governance.
* 3+ years in IT operations, application management, or business team leadership.
* 3+ years in business relationship management, including executive-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated knowledge of information security frameworks, ITGC controls, and compliance methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead teams and manage large-scale, concurrent SAP programs.
* Strong communication skills across technical, business, and senior leadership audiences.
* HIPAA Training and Supervisors Orientation (within 30 days of hire); Leadership Development 101 (within one year); Costco Pay Policies (within 90 days of promotion).

**Recommended:**

* Experience with SAP products including S/4HANA, Cloud ALM, GRC, ETD and SAP Security.
* Background in global SAP rollouts, including EU or multi-region programs.
* Familiarity with defining, reporting, and remediating compliance metrics and risks.
* Experience developing long-term strategic plans and driving team goal achievement.
* Ability to operate as a self-starter under limited supervision.
* Proficient in Google Workspace applications, including Sheets, Docs, Slides, and Gmail.
* Successful internal candidates will have spent one year or more on their current team.

**Other Conditions:**

* Management will review the Job Analysis for this position prior to a job offer

title: Senior Consultant - EDM
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Argano is seeking a dynamic and experienced EPM Data Integrations Manager to lead and manage a high-performing team of consulting professionals. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the delivery of consulting services to clients, ensuring quality and efficiency in project execution, and fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment. **Responsibilities**

* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings with team members to provide feedback, set goals, and ensure professional growth.
* Foster a positive and collaborative team culture that encourages continuous learning and innovation.
* Oversee workload distribution, ensuring that projects are staffed appropriately and deadlines are met.
* Ensure the quality of deliverables and services provided by the consulting team, ensuring they meet company standards and client expectations.
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, client satisfaction, and team productivity.
* Support the sales and business development process by identifying new opportunities within existing client accounts and assisting with proposals, RFPs, and presentations.
* Collaborate with senior leadership to assist in defining the strategic direction for the EPM consulting practice and identify new service offerings.
* Contribute to thought leadership by staying current with industry trends and best practices, and representing the company at conferences, webinars, and networking events.

**Education**
**MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related field.

**Experience**

* 7+ years of experience architecting, implementing, and supporting Oracle EPM Data Integrations solutions.
* Strong proficiency in Oracle Hyperion EPM Suite (On-Premise and Cloud), including Data Exchange, Financial Data Quality Management Enterprise Edition (FDMEE), SQL and Groovy scripting. Familiarity with Enterprise Data Management (EDM) is highly desirable.
* Proven track record of successfully managing and leading teams in a consulting or professional services environment.
* Strong understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and best practices (PMP or similar certifications are a plus).
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both clients and internal teams.
* Demonstrate the ability to manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously while maintaining high levels of client satisfaction.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering actionable insights and solutions.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and drive results under pressure.
* Flexibility for travel

**About Us**
Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
  
  
Argano is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Team Leader, Operations
description:
**Job Title**
Team Leader, Operations
  
  
**Job Description**
The Team Leader, Operations is responsible for the day-to-day supervision of a group of call center associates. This position ensures performance metrics are achieved by providing adequate coaching, motivation and accountability.
  
  
Concentrix is a technology-enabled global business services company specializing in customer engagement and improving business performance. We partner with ambitious, progressive executives around the world to future-proof their business and stay ahead of the competition and customer expectations.
  
  

* Job Description: Team Leader (TL) – Fraud Back Office

*This role focuses on operational volume management, financial risk mitigation, compliance, and end-to-end SLA delivery for complex processing queues.*

* Position: Team Leader, Operations (Fraud Back Office)
* Job Location: Hyderabad
* Total Experience: 8+ Years
* Relevant Experience: 5+ Years in Fraud/Disputes/Recoveries Back Office Operations

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* SLA & Inventory Management: Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across back-office queues (Application Fraud, Disputes, and Recoveries) ensuring zero backlog accumulation.
* Performance Management: Track, review, and drive individual and team metrics such as Turnaround Time (TAT), Processing Accuracy, and Quality Scores.
* Financial Risk Mitigation: Provide operational oversight over high-value fraud claims, dispute cycles, and fund recovery workflows to minimize operational leakages and net credit losses.
* Process Audits & Compliance: Ensure all team processing strictly adheres to regulatory banking compliance guidelines and card network dispute mandates.
* RCA & Client Reporting: Conduct comprehensive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on process errors, financial misses, or fraud leaks. Present findings and operational updates in weekly/monthly business reviews (WBR/MBR).
* People Development: Conduct regular one-on-one coaching, career planning, and performance management reviews. Drive succession planning by grooming SMEs into future leadership roles.

Desired Domain Expertise
  
  

* Deep structural knowledge of the end-to-end dispute lifecycle, specifically governing representment response windows and pre-arbitration (pre-arb) filing criteria.
* Strong functional knowledge of card backend chargeback cycles, card-not-present fraud, and asset recovery/beneficiary bank recall logic.
* Expert capacity planning skills to manage volume volatility across multiple back-office processing workflows.
* Job Description: Team Leader (TL) – Fraud Voice

*This role focuses on real-time telephony management, customer satisfaction, active risk containment, and contact center service levels.*

* Position: Team Leader, Operations (Fraud Voice)
* Job Location: Hyderabad
* Total Experience: 8+ Years
* Relevant Experience: 5+ Years in a Fraud Voice / Banking Contact Center environment

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Intraday Telephony Metrics: Monitor real-time queue traffic, schedule adherence, and critical voice metrics including Service Level (SL), Abandonment Rate, and Average Handling Time (AHT).
* Customer Experience (CX) Governance: Drive team strategies to maximize First Contact Resolution (FCR), Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), and Net Promoter Scores (NPS) while navigating high-friction fraud situations.
* De-escalation Oversight: Manage high-risk live call escalations, executive complaints, and critical vulnerability scenarios (e.g., active identity theft or wallet compromises).
* Quality Assurance & Calibration: Lead call calibration sessions with the Quality Assurance (QA) team to ensure agents remain highly compliant with regulatory and security verification steps.
* Incident Management: Coordinate immediate, cross-functional actions during emergency fraud attack trends or system outages affecting telephone lines.
* Coaching & Engagement: Utilize regular call-listening and performance data to provide targeted behavioral coaching, boosting agent confidence and empathy levels on fraud calls.

Desired Domain Expertise
  
  

* Deep understanding of telephony platforms, workforce management practices, and IVR routing rules.
* Mastery over security/identity authentication parameters (KYC, customer verification steps) and handling distressed victims of fraud.

**Educational qualification**
: Any Graduate or Masters

description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
The Agency Lending Operations Vice President is a leadership role responsible for overseeing the operational support of Agency lending activities, including the Inventory Management of client sell/recall requests, cash investment management support, Earnings/Billing processes, and Client Reporting requirements. This role ensures complete and timely recall coverage, accurate cash management and monthly earnings/billing payment processing/tracking, and client reporting requirements, while leading a global team and driving strategic improvements. The position also involves close collaboration with business partners to drive innovation in processes and systems to enhance efficiency, scalability, and risk management, ensuring operational solutions are closely aligned with State Street’s business objectives, industry practices, and evolving market needs.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to the SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As an Agency Lending Operations Vice President you will cover –
  
  

* Inventory Management
* Oversee daily processing of client recall requests (daily sells, proxy voting recalls, liquidations, rebalances, ad hoc client requests) across markets
* Ensure recall coverage is timely and aligns with needed returns
* Partner with global custody teams on trade statuses, adjustments
* Manage sell fail claims, TMPG, CSDR, buy-ins
* Track sell related stats for client management
* Cash Management, Earnings, Billing
* Forecast and facilitate cash collateral investments in and out of vehicles
* Perform balance proof with investment vehicles
* Ensure accurate monthly Client/Bank earnings reconciliation and distribution
* Reconcile, track, and settle Borrower billing payments/receipts
* Cash account reconciliations; billing dispute management
* Client Reporting
* Lead client reporting function, serving as key liaison across clients, operations, and technology to deliver accurate, scalable, and controlled reporting solutions
* Manage inquiries and escalations, coordinating across internal functions to deliver timely and effective solutions
* Support strategic initiatives and new products by assessing upstream/downstream impacts to client reporting and devising solutions to meet client data needs
* Risk & Control
* Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, and counterparty risks
* Ensure strong internal controls and adherence to audit requirements
* Investigate and resolve cash breaks, fails, and counterparty discrepancies
* Provide viable solutions and KRI’s to reduce and/or eliminate risk to Agency Lending, State Street, and its clients
* Regulatory Compliance
* Ensure all Agency Lending operational processes comply with relevant regulations, internal policies, and industry standards
* Support reporting requirements and regulatory audits
* Participate and track internal and external audits throughout the year, ensuring all deliverables and action items are handled timely
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of evolving regulatory/market changes
* Stakeholder Management
* Partner with Front Office, Risk, and Technology teams to understand requirements, delivering solutions that support business growth and risk mitigation
* Act as escalation point for operational issues working with teams to resolve and/or remove road blocks, and ensuring management transparency
* Maintain relationships with counterparties, custodians, and clearing agents
* Partner with custody teams that support trade management
* Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners, ensuring optimal performance and value from third-party platforms and services
* Team Leadership
* Manage and coach operations staff and AVPs
* Drive performance, training, and development
* Promote a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
* Process Improvement & Projects
* Identify emerging technologies and process improvements to drive operational efficiency, trading profitability, risk reduction, and enhanced client experience with Agency Lending products
* Participate in system implementations and strategic transformation programs
* Enhance scalability and efficiency of operations
* Partner with business leaders, risk, compliance, and technology teams to understand requirements, delivering solutions that support business growth and risk mitigation

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or related field is preferred
* 12+ years of experience in financial services operations, with focus on Agency lending
* Strong understanding of Agency Lending products and processes (e.g., trade lifecycle management/collateral, Earnings/Billing, vendors)

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Leadership and team management
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Attention to detail and risk awareness
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Process improvement and project management

**Additional Details**

* Fast-paced environment
* High interaction with trading desks/client management, counterparties, and global custody teams
* Time-sensitive operations aligned with market hours

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
  
  
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: City Head
description:
**City PnL Head – Coliving**

**Zolo | Coliving Business**

Own the city. Drive occupancy. Build systems. Deliver predictable growth.

**Why this role exists**

In coliving, a city is not just a geography.

It is a full business unit with its own demand, occupancy, cost structure, customer experience, and operational complexity.

At city level:

* Demand fluctuates continuously
* Supply is fragmented across multiple properties
* Resident expectations evolve constantly
* Execution gaps immediately affect occupancy and retention

Without strong city-level ownership, operations quickly become reactive.

The biggest failures usually happen when:

* Occupancy is managed week-to-week instead of structurally
* Sales and operations work independently instead of as one system
* Cost leakages go unnoticed
* Accountability weakens across teams
* Escalations consume operational bandwidth daily

As scale increases, the city must operate with:

* Predictability
* Commercial discipline
* Structured execution
* Strong leadership ownership

This role exists to ensure:

* The city runs like a disciplined business unit
* Occupancy remains stable across cycles
* Demand generation stays strong and diversified
* Resident experience remains consistent across properties
* Costs are controlled structurally, not reactively
* Teams operate with ownership and accountability
* Escalations reduce through system-led fixes

If this role is strong:

* Occupancy becomes predictable
* Margins improve consistently
* Teams operate independently and efficiently
* Retention strengthens
* Growth becomes scalable

If this role is weak:

* Occupancy volatility increases
* Conversion weakens
* Costs rise without control
* Escalations dominate operations
* Customer experience becomes inconsistent

This role directly controls:
**Revenue + occupancy + retention + profitability + team performance**

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own city-level revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* Build strong demand generation engines
* Ensure consistent resident experience across properties
* Drive renewals and improve retention
* Control operational costs and eliminate leakages
* Build high-performing sales and operations teams
* Reduce escalations structurally through systems

**This is not a coordination role. This is a full city P&L ownership role.**

**About Coliving – Zolo**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Coliving works only when:

* Demand remains strong
* Occupancy stays high
* Resident experience remains consistent
* Operations are disciplined
* Costs stay under control

At scale:
**City becomes the core operating unit of the business.**

This role directly impacts:
**Revenue + occupancy + retention + operational efficiency + profitability**

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Own City Business Performance (P&L Ownership)**

* Own city-level revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* Track daily occupancy, booking trends, and pipeline visibility
* Drive predictable performance across properties
* Improve operational and commercial efficiency continuously
* Think in business outcomes, not activities

**2. Build Demand Generation & Sales Performance**

* Build strong local demand channels:
* Colleges
* Corporates
* Brokers
* Local partnerships
* Improve lead-to-booking conversion across the funnel
* Track funnel performance actively:
* Leads
* Visits
* Bookings
* Reduce funnel leakage systematically
* Ensure strong alignment between sales and occupancy goals

**3. Drive Operations & Resident Experience Excellence**

* Ensure SOP adherence across all properties
* Maintain consistent resident experience standards
* Track complaint patterns and escalation trends
* Drive audits and operational improvements proactively
* Ensure operational discipline across teams

**4. Improve Occupancy & Retention**

* Maintain stable occupancy across seasonal cycles
* Drive renewals and reduce churn proactively
* Identify early retention risk signals
* Improve resident continuity and relationship quality
* Ensure smooth admission and move-in experience

**5. Ensure Cost Control & Commercial Discipline**

* Track property-level cost vs budget consistently
* Identify operational leakages proactively
* Ensure vendor discipline and commercial accountability
* Balance resident experience with cost efficiency
* Drive profitability without compromising core standards

**6. Build Strong Teams & Leadership Depth**

* Lead city-level sales and operations teams
* Set targets and review performance regularly
* Build second-line leadership capability
* Act decisively on underperformance
* Create a strong ownership and accountability culture

**7. Handle Escalations & Operational Risks**

* Handle critical resident, parent, or safety escalations calmly
* Ensure structured issue resolution and follow-through
* Reduce repeat escalations through root-cause fixes
* Protect resident trust and brand reputation
* Maintain operational stability during pressure situations

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Occupancy becomes stable and predictable
* Conversion improves consistently across the funnel
* Renewal and retention rates strengthen
* Cost variance remains within planned thresholds
* Complaint repeat rates reduce significantly
* Teams operate with stronger ownership and accountability
* City operations become system-led instead of escalation-led

The city begins to operate like:
**A disciplined and scalable business unit**

Performance becomes:
**Structured + Predictable + Scalable**

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You think in business outcomes instead of tasks
* You can manage multiple operational levers simultaneously
* You balance execution speed with structure
* You are data-driven and action-oriented
* You are comfortable handling ownership and pressure
* You focus on building systems instead of temporary fixes

**Experience we value**

5–8+ years in:

* Operations
* Sales
* Business management roles
* Experience managing:
* Multi-property operations
* Multi-unit business environments
* City-level execution
* Exposure to:
* P&L ownership
* Demand generation
* Operations management
* Cost control

Industry matters less.
**Business ownership maturity matters more.**

**The impact you will have**

* Direct impact on city revenue and profitability
* Build scalable demand and operations systems
* Improve occupancy and retention structurally
* Develop strong leadership pipelines
* Drive long-term city-level business growth

**Why join now**

Coliving is entering its scale phase.

The businesses that win will be defined by:
**City-level execution excellence.**

This role offers:

* Full city business ownership
* High visibility and strategic impact
* Fast growth into regional leadership roles

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity.

IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals.

Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market.

**Role**

We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-impact programmes across multiple engineering teams. This senior role is the critical connective layer between engineering, product, architecture, and leadership. responsible for resolving cross-team dependencies, driving delivery of intricate technical projects, and ensuring predictable, high-quality outcomes at scale. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency combined with exceptional programme management skills, and thrives in navigating ambiguity across distributed, multi-disciplinary teams within a regulated fintech environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cross-Team Dependency & Complex Delivery Management**

* Own and drive resolution of cross-team technical dependencies across 8–12+ engineering squads
* Establish and maintain programme-level dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths
* Lead planning and execution of complex, multi-team deliveries spanning months or multiple quarters
* Identify inter-team blockers early and orchestrate timely resolution with engineering leads and architects
* Coordinate integration milestones, shared API contracts, and platform-level dependencies across squads

**Delivery & Release Governance**

* Define and enforce delivery governance frameworks for large-scale technical programmes
* Ensure production readiness through structured release checkpoints, go/no-go criteria, and sign-off processes
* Oversee end-to-end release management across parallel workstreams, coordinating across QA, DevOps, and Platform teams
* Monitor programme health, critical path, and execution risks; escalate proactively to leadership
* Drive standardization of release and deployment governance across the engineering organization

**Technical Programme Leadership**

* Partner with Engineering Leads, Principal Engineers, and Architects to translate technical strategy into actionable delivery plans
* Lead structured programme ceremonies: dependency syncs, architecture reviews, cross-team planning, and programme-level retrospectives
* Maintain and evolve Agile and hybrid delivery frameworks tailored to programme complexity and team maturity
* Drive PI Planning and large-scale increment coordination across product and platform squads

**Stakeholder & Executive Engagement**

* Serve as the primary delivery interface for senior stakeholders, CTO, and executive leadership on complex programmes
* Produce clear, data-driven programme status reports, risk dashboards, and delivery forecasts for leadership review
* Translate complex technical interdependencies into business-level impact narratives for non-technical audiences
* Proactively manage expectations, surface trade-offs, and recommend delivery options under constraint

**Tooling & Delivery Intelligence**

* Own and evolve programme-level Jira structures including epics hierarchies, dependency links, cross-project boards, and automation
* Drive delivery intelligence through advanced metrics: cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, dependency resolution SLAs.
* Build and maintain executive-level dashboards that surface programme health, risk, and delivery confidence
* Ensure tooling practices support audit readiness and compliance requirements in a regulated financial services environment

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* 10+ years in Technical Delivery Management, Programme Management, or Engineering Leadership roles
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi-team technical programmes in a regulated or high-stakes environment
* Deep expertise in cross-team dependency management across large engineering organizations (8+ teams)
* Strong technical fluency; ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects, and platform teams on technical trade-offs
* Extensive experience with Agile at scale frameworks and hybrid delivery models
* Advanced Jira administration, programme-level workflow design, and delivery metrics expertise

description:

Over the next 5+ years, we will have to efficiently run all the large business critical upgrades with 100% efficiency & no disruption to business – factoring in the deeply integrated global landscape.
  
  
The upgrade planning manager is a strategic role which develops and maintains the PepsiCo SAP multi year upgrade strategy in collaboration with SAP and PepsiCo teams
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Primary
  
  

* 'Own the multi-year SAP upgrade roadmap across all PepsiCo platforms, markets and regions
* Prioritize upgrade initiatives based on risk, business value, innovation, and SAP support deadlines
* Identify and resolve cross-program dependencies and conflicts before execution begins
* Align with SAP/vendor roadmaps, licensing changes, and product lifecycle milestone
* Develop AOP plans including funding, resources, environments, and governance approvals
* Maintain and promote a single source of truth at the system ID level in the applications' inventory

Shared
  
  

* Partner with Infrastructure and Cloud teams to align upgrade roadmaps with hosting capacity, environment strategy, and platform modernization plans
* Partner with Functional/DSO teams and Product Owners to prioritize upgrades based on business value, risk, and operational calendars
* Partner with Testing teams to estimate effort and reserve test windows, environments, and long-range regression capacity for upcoming releases
* Partner with SAP/Vendors and Architecture teams to assess dependencies, product lifecycle changes, and required remediation actions-
* Partner with Modernization team ensuring there is a wholistic view of the global SAP roadmap and north start which includes not only Upgrades but also modernization re-platform applications

Decision Rights
  
  

* Approve and maintain the multi-year SAP upgrade roadmap, sequencing, and prioritization of initiatives
* Decide go/no-go for entering execution based on readiness, dependencies, funding, and resource availability
* Decide whether upgrades priorities should be changed, accelerated or deferred based on risk and business priorities

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in SAP programs, ERP transformations, or enterprise technology strategy-Proven experience building multi-year roadmaps for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, cloud, and adjacent platforms
* Strong knowledge of SAP product lifecycle, maintenance deadlines, licensing, and vendor governance
* Experience managing cross-functional dependencies across infrastructure, security, data, testing, and business teams
* Executive presence with ability to influence senior leadership, secure funding, and drive prioritization decisions

The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end-to-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. **Technical and Professional Requirements:**

* 8-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**

* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

**Technical Skills:**

* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post-implementation support.

**Industry Knowledge:**

* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

**Client Management**

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement
* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution

**Solution Design**

* End-to-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)
* Business process optimization using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies; identification of automation opportunities and efficiency gains
* Integration strategy development including point-to-point, hub-based, and API-led connectivity approaches
* Oversight of custom development (ABAP, SAPUI5, BRF+) ensuring adherence to SAP standards and maintainability

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project and program management using methodologies such as SAP Activate, Agile, or hybrid approaches.
* Leadership of diverse teams (10-30+ members) including onshore, nearshore, and offshore resources across functional and technical disciplines
* Quality assurance practices including test strategy development, UAT coordination, cutover planning, and post-go-live support
* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery

* Desired to have SAP certification on SAP TM.

* Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in SAP TM.

title: Manager, Data Aggregation & Distribution L2 Support
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Manager for Data Aggregation & Distribution L2 Support to join our team. As a Manager for Data Aggregation & Distribution L2 Support, you will drive critical data operations that enable clinical research at scale. This position plays a key role in leading technical support teams, ensuring data pipeline reliability, maintaining regulatory compliance, and delivering exceptional service to internal and external stakeholders. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, establish best practices, and contribute to data platform excellence from strategy through execution. Responsibilities include overseeing L2 support operations, leading and developing high-performing teams, and driving continuous improvement across Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Denodo, and Power BI environments.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through supporting data-driven clinical research, building technical excellence, and advancing data platform capabilities. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Manager for Data Aggregation & Distribution L2 Support can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research technology and data operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, manage, and develop a team of 14 L2 data support specialists, providing clear direction, coaching, and performance oversight to foster a high-performance culture.
* Oversee the triage, diagnosis, and resolution of data pipeline, ingestion, and distribution issues, acting as an escalation point for complex technical problems.
* Monitor support queue performance and service levels, ensuring timely issue resolution and maintaining agreed SLAs across all data platforms.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders including platform data teams, data engineering, analytics, and business functions to identify requirements and resolve recurring issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve data support operations, pipeline reliability, and team efficiency through continuous process improvement and innovation.
* Maintain and enforce support procedures, runbooks, and escalation protocols while ensuring team adherence to IT procedures, quality standards, and data governance requirements.

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strong people management and team leadership capability with a proven track record of building and developing high-performing teams.
* Experience with cloud data platforms including Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, and Denodo, with hands-on knowledge of data pipeline monitoring and troubleshooting.
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* A data-focused mindset with strong attention to detail, analytical problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities under pressure.
* Comfort working with ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow), ticketing systems, and modern cloud-based solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent work experience).
* 2-5 years of demonstrated experience managing technical support or data operations teams, preferably in an enterprise or CRO environment.
* Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, preferably Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, and Denodo.
* Proven experience supporting or operating within Medallion Architecture-based Data Lake environments.
* Track record of leading and developing teams of 10 or more technical staff.
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant cloud platform certifications (e.g., Microsoft Azure Data Engineer, Databricks Certified Associate).
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent service management qualification.
* Experience managing L2 support functions including escalation management and SLA ownership.
* Familiarity with GxP or regulated life sciences data environments.
* Experience with data governance and quality standards in enterprise environments.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Head of Digital Finance Hyderabad Hub
description:

The Head of Digital Finance Hyderabad Hub leads a cross-functional team that plays a central role in advancing the Finance transformation agenda at Novartis. title: Credit Controller
description:
SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over 2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries, supported by a team of 99,500 dedicated professionals. With over 145 years of service excellence, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve the highest standards of quality, compliance, and sustainability.
  
  
  
  
SGS is looking for a
**Credit Controller**
with a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field and
**5–7 years of relevant experience.**

**Job Description**

Key Responsibilities

* Review customer credit applications, assess payment terms, evaluate credit risk, and recommend approval, rejection, or revision based on company policy and commercial requirements.
* Maintain accurate customer credit records, approved payment terms, credit limits, risk classifications, and payment history documentation.
* Monitor overdue receivables, aging reports, disputed invoices, and high-risk accounts to ensure timely action and escalation.
* Proactively follow up with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve overdue balances, payment delays, disputes, and blocked collections.
* Negotiate payment plans and credit arrangements within approved guidelines while balancing commercial needs and credit risk controls.
* Communicate credit decisions, collection status, overdue risks, and escalation items clearly to relevant stakeholders and management.
* Prepare regular credit control reports, overdue analysis, cash collection commentary, risk summaries, and bad debt exposure updates.
* Support month-end close activities by reviewing AR aging, expected collections, provisions, write-off recommendations, and disputed balances.
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen collection effectiveness, reduce overdue balances, and enhance cash flow visibility.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, delegation of authority, credit procedures, VAT requirements, and audit expectations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5–7 years of relevant experience in Credit Control, Collections, Accounts Receivable, Finance Operations, or customer risk management.
* Strong understanding of credit assessment, collections, customer payment terms, AR aging, dispute management, provisions, and bad debt controls.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as Oracle, SUN Systems, SAP, or similar finance platforms is highly desirable.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, reconciliations, and structured reporting.
* Exposure to Power BI, credit risk tools, automated collection platforms, and banking systems would be an added advantage.

**Additional Information**

Key Competencies

* Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Sound judgment in assessing customer risk, payment behavior, and credit exposure.
* Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to prioritize overdue accounts, manage escalations, and work under strict deadlines.
* High attention to detail, professionalism, confidentiality, and commitment to financial control.

title: Senior Accountant,GAOC
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Finance & Accounting Group, Finance & Accounting Group > Global Accounting Ops Center
  
  
**General Summary**
Qualcomm Controllership Team
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Accountant at the Global Accounting Operations Center (GAOC) serves as a strategic partner within Qualcomm’s Controllership Team, leading global closing and reporting activities. This role is responsible for driving excellence in General Accounting, Treasury, Receivables, Cash & Banking, Payments, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Payroll, and more. The Senior Accountant leverages and experienced in
**AI, automation, analytics, and audit technologies**
to optimize accounting operations, ensure financial integrity, and support forward-thinking business initiatives. The ideal candidate will champion intelligent process enhancements and adopt data-driven insights to transform finance operations at scale.
  
  
**Core AI-Driven Finance And Accounting Responsibilities**

* Lead US GAAP general accounting using advanced AI tools and automation platforms to ensure accuracy and efficiency in all entries and documentation.
* Oversee month-end close, including journal preparation, posting, ledger and trial balance review, and variance analysis, utilizing AI for process optimization and meeting business deadlines.
* Maintain and analyze the general ledger, applying analytics and AI-driven tools for revenue and cost recognition; perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations per Qualcomm policy.
* Act as a subject matter expert for designated accounts, providing insight through automated analysis and reporting.
* Prepare and remediate quarterly balance sheet analyses using AI-powered review solutions.
* Deliver timely HQ and ad hoc reports, leveraging automation for accuracy and efficiency.
* Recommend, design, and implement improvements to ledger systems and workflows, emphasizing automation and AI-assisted standardization.
* Support local controllership during audits with automated documentation and compliance in local GAAP and international accounting standards.
* Ensure compliance with Internal Audit and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements, integrating AI-driven control and monitoring where possible.
* Maintain a flexible approach to additional duties, encouraging adaptability and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**AI & Automation Focus Areas**

* Automation & Process Optimization: Lead the deployment of RPA and AI-based workflow solutions to streamline and innovate accounting operations.
* AI & Machine Learning: Utilize artificial intelligence for forecasting, anomaly detection, and process enhancements across all accounting cycles.
* Advanced Analytics: Employ analytics platforms (Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Excel) for data interpretation and decision support, integrating AI tools for deeper insights.
* Audit Excellence: Deliver audit-ready documentation and support, incorporating AI for SOX, IFRS, and process design.

**AI-Integrated Qualifications & Requirements**

* CPA or Chartered Accountant degree in Finance/Accounting, with 4–8 years’ experience in a multi-GAAP, shared service environment.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle and SAP GA modules, and demonstrated ability to leverage ERP and AI solutions.
* Exceptional English communication skills, with emphasis on presenting analytics and AI-derived insights.
* Proven ability to learn and adapt to new standards, processes, and technologies rapidly, especially in AI and automation.
* Strong organizational and prioritization abilities; detail-oriented and skilled at data-driven decision-making.
* Flexible, collaborative, and innovative mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement through technology.
* Professional interpersonal skills; effective communicator and team player in a technology-driven environment.
* Comfortable achieving results against quantitative and qualitative performance metrics, utilizing automation where possible.
* Advanced IT skills, including Excel and Outlook, plus experience in AI and analytics platforms.
* Experience in a large multinational company preferred.
* Preferred: CPA certification and demonstrated proficiency in AI-driven Record-to-Report (R2R) activities.

This opportunity is tailored for visionary professionals eager to transform finance through
**AI, automation, advanced analytics, and audit innovation**
, setting new standards in accounting excellence.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree.
* 4+ years of Finance, Accounting, or related work experience.
* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

title: Deputy Manager, Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) - Transformation and Optimization - Data Strategist - Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
The incumbent will work with Enterprise Operations Xcellence Transformation and Optimization (ETO) team’s Data & Analytics function, helping build and run a central data & analytics platform that serves all EOX teams with trusted data, models, and reporting. The role frames problems, builds and runs scenario and trade-off analyses, designs data models and reporting frameworks, and develops clear, well-supported recommendations for stakeholders and leadership — while also stewarding the underlying data (architecture, cataloging, standards, and quality) so the platform remains a reliable, reusable asset rather than a one-off deliverable.
  
  
This role is highly hands-on, working directly with data and stakeholders to produce rigorous, credible analysis, and partners closely with the Data & Analytics Associate Director on recommendations that inform cross-functional decisions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Specialist Deputy Manager, Analytics and Insights on the Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Framing ambiguous business problems into structured questions, hypotheses, and decision frameworks that can be analyzed and acted on.
* Building scenario, optimization, and trade-off analyses; developing data models and reporting frameworks; and producing repeatable reporting for EOX teams.
* Partnering with data engineering to shape the architecture, pipelines, and structure of the central data and analytics platform.
* Governing data quality, cataloging, lineage, definitions, metric standards, and schema standards to support a consistent source of truth.
* Working with stakeholders and leaders across EOX process areas to prioritize analytics demand, build self-service reporting solutions, and develop executive-ready recommendations.

**The team**
Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) focuses on improving operational effectiveness, driving transformation execution, and enabling scalable, consistent, and high-quality outcomes across the organization. The team works across process areas to strengthen governance, improve delivery discipline, and embed more efficient ways of working, including AI-enabled support for reporting, risk visibility, action management, communications, training, and adoption.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
2 PM to 11 PM
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, data and analytics, statistics, engineering, mathematics, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in data analysis, business analytics, strategy, or another analytical role
* Experience building scenario models, optimization analyses, or trade-off analyses for business decision-making
* Experience designing data models and reporting frameworks for repeatable analysis and reporting
* Experience using SQL and Python for analysis
* Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience working with modern data platforms such as Databricks and version control tools such as Git

Preferred:
  
  

* Master’s degree in business, data and analytics, statistics, engineering, mathematics, or a related field
* Experience partnering with data engineering teams on data architecture and pipelines
* Experience with data cataloging or governance tools such as Unity Catalog, Purview, or Collibra
* Experience defining metric standards, schema standards, or key performance indicator governance
* Experience with AI-enabled analytics tools such as natural-language-to-SQL or generative AI-assisted analysis
* Experience building self-service dashboards, templates, or internal analytics products

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Finance: Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe
description:
Job Title
  
  
Finance Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe
  
  
**Job Description**
Are you a finance professional with a strong background in tax, compliance, and financial governance? Do you enjoy combining technical expertise with team leadership, process improvement, and collaboration across multiple European countries?
  
  
At Vanderlande, we are looking for a Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe who will lead the regional Tax & Compliance team and help ensure a strong and compliant tax framework across our European operations.
  
  
In this role, you will contribute to managing tax risks, ensuring regulatory compliance, improving processes and controls, and supporting the business with practical tax solutions in a dynamic international environment.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**
As Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe, you report to the Team Lead Tax & Compliance EU / LATAM and lead a team of tax and compliance professionals supporting the European organization.
  
  
You will oversee day-to-day tax compliance activities within Europe and provide guidance on tax matters across multiple countries, working closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders.
  
  
You will combine solid tax expertise with people leadership and a continuous improvement mindset, ensuring tax compliance processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and consistently across the region.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you will
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop the Europe Tax & Compliance team.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of tax compliance and reporting activities across Europe.
* Coordinate corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and other relevant tax compliance activities in cooperation with Group Tax and local Finance teams.
* Support transfer pricing compliance activities and documentation requirements.
* Act as a key contact for tax authorities, auditors, external advisors, and internal stakeholders on operational tax matters.
* Identify and manage tax risks, ensuring issues are escalated and addressed appropriately.
* Translate changes in tax legislation into practical guidance and actions for the business.
* Maintain and improve tax controls, documentation, and compliance processes.
* Drive standardization and process improvements across European tax and compliance activities.
* Identify recurring issues and implement sustainable solutions.
* Support business projects and operational activities with practical tax advice.
* Contribute to finance transformation, compliance, and process improvement initiatives.
* Build strong relationships with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business teams.
* Support knowledge sharing and consistent application of Group Tax policies across Europe.

**What do we ask from you?**
We ask you to bring experience, education, and personality
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Tax, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in tax, tax compliance, or a related finance function within an international environment.
* Experience leading, coaching, or coordinating a team.
* Good knowledge of corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and general tax compliance requirements.
* Experience working with tax authorities, auditors, and external advisors.
* Experience with process improvement and standardization initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* A proactive, pragmatic, and solution-oriented mindset.
* A collaborative leader who combines technical expertise with a strong service-oriented approach.

**About The Team**
You will join the global FSSC organization and become part of a collaborative international finance community. The Europe Tax & Compliance team supports the region in meeting tax and regulatory obligations while helping the business operate efficiently and compliantly in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment.
  
  
The team works closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders to strengthen compliance, mitigate risks, and continuously improve ways of working.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer a position in an international and professional working environment with room for personal development and growth.
  
  
This position offers a competitive salary range of € 6.500 to € 7.600 gross per month (excluding 8% holiday allowance).
  
  
On top of your fixed salary, you’ll receive the following secondary benefits
  
  

* 40 vacation days (20 statutory days and a flexible budget worth 20 days)
* Flexible working hours
* A hybrid workplace (40% working from home and 60% in the office)
* A Health & Wellbeing budget worth € 300 per calendar year.
* Commuting allowance, including full reimbursement of travel by public transport
* Working from home allowance
* Collective pension scheme and discount on additional health insurance
* On-site company health centres with a gym, physiotherapists and occupational therapists
* Vanderlande Academy and training facilities to boost your skills
* A variety in Vanderlande Network communities and initiatives

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande designs, delivers and supports automation solutions, operational software and lifecycle services for leading airports and parcel operations worldwide. Our solutions help customers improve performance, reliability, and sustainable growth in more than 100 countries. How we work matters just as much as what we deliver. Our values, Every Day Better, We Care, and Team Play, guide how we collaborate, support each other, and create value for our customers.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV.
  
  
Questions about this role? Contact Carlijn Kneepkens (Recruiter) at carlijn.kneepkens@vanderlande.com.
  
  
**Diversity & inclusion**
Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Sr. Supervisor Operations Management [T500-30249]
description:
**About CIBC:**

CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.

**About CIBC India:**

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

The Senior Supervisor, Retail Account Services REBO is accountable for providing leadership and management of staff members within a medium/moderately complex operational unit, as defined in the standard operating guidelines, to achieve high performance levels and outstanding customer service. The incumbent will oversee direct and in-direct reports for an operational unit with multiple processes requiring different procedures with varied complexity. Manage all escalated issues based on knowledge, experience and procedures to identify root cause and make sound decisions ensuring resolution of more complex issues/problems. Influence and communicate with other departments for improved results on behalf of senior management. Manage employee development and operational effectiveness, implementation of strategic initiatives, ongoing communication and assisting business partners.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

**Provide leadership and ongoing employee development to staff within operating unit:**

* Manage and administer Performance Management & Measurement Process (e.g. develop and communicate productivity targets/results, conduct interim and annual reviews) to ensure Individual Development Plans are in place and developmental opportunities are identified for all direct reports
* Monitor, evaluate and manage day-to-day employee performance to identify gaps and develop action plans to achieve optimum performance results (e.g. Performance Improvement Plan, Terminations)
* Lead, motivate, mentor and guide staff providing regular coaching and feedback to ensure employees can perform at or developing to the necessary standards; provide industry specific expertise to resolve complex issues and develop problem-solving capability within all team members
* Maintain focus on employee satisfaction levels and take corrective action to ensure all human resources decisions are adhered to and all issues are addressed
* Identify training needs for staff and ensure employees are trained, cross-trained and knowledgeable about products, services, policies, processes and procedures to maintain proficiency on the job
* Anticipate staffing needs for the department; manage staffing activities with Resourcing to interview, make hiring decisions, complete documentation and ensure orientation of new employees
* Promote CIBC’s Achievers Rewards and Recognition Program communicating program structure and criteria and recognizing high performing employees who exceed expectations
* Initiate team-building activities with direct reports (e.g. huddles, team meetings) to actively engage staff, encourage team spirit and create a positive employee experience to build team capability

**Manage day-to-day operation / production activities including resource allocation, budgeting, change integration, system operation and process improvement in the delivery of services:**

* Plan and schedule the daily activities of staff including coverage for holidays, absentees and peak work periods to ensure Service Level Agreements are met or exceeded with minimal overtime
* Manage the unit costs against pre-established budget (e.g. AIP, salary administration, FTE resource allocation, overtime, daily expense costs) and forecasting for all direct reports to ensure operational efficiency and profitability
* Manage work volumes to meet deliverable standards with minimal overtime and monitor, delegate and distribute workload to ensure efficient and equitable workflow
* Prepare monthly variance explanations; provide LE assistance and payroll/Peoplesoft administration support (e.g. input, balancing, verification, production reporting); participate and/or take ownership in some areas of fiscal year financial planning to ensure profitability
* Review established processes regularly to ensure their validity/effectiveness; perform root cause analysis to identify opportunities for improving control processes and procedural adherence and make recommendations to support continuous improvement, cost containment and operational efficiencies

**Perform and resolve difficult or complex departmental procedures or problems, including appropriate inter-departmental or external communications to ensure client satisfaction:**

* Establish and maintain a communication and escalation process to respond to issues reported by customers, vendors, internal and external business partners
* Manage all escalated issues based on knowledge, experience and procedures; make sound decisions to ensure resolution of issues/problems prior to escalating to senior management
* Ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality service through service excellence principles to meet or exceed client expectations and service standards
* Ensure an appropriate communication process is in place to facilitate sharing of information (e.g. ensure service level expectations are clearly articulated/attained, keep team updated on business goals, strategies, performance objectives, current issue/concerns and new procedures or changes)
* Lead regular team meetings to resolve issues and concerns and communicate as required
* Provide consultative services to internal business partners; liaise with and elicit cooperation from other departments within Retail Operations to enhance service delivery

**Manage risk within department and ensure compliance to policies, procedures and controls to minimize losses and support adherence to completeness and accuracy:**

* Ensure business unit activities are within compliance by completing random spot checks and testing
* Identify, anticipate and detect potential problems and take accountability for making informed, independent decisions to find alternative solutions to eliminate any potential risk
* Review and complete Quarterly Key Compliance Reports to ensure documented procedures, processes and policies are followed; analyze trends, determine root cause and take appropriate action to resolve issues/concerns ensuring Corporate Governance approval is received as required
* Review tracking on a daily, weekly or monthly basis (e.g. productivity tracking) to ensure accurate counts and reflect the financial result by reducing revenue leakage
* Ensure safety and security of premises and buildings for protection of CIBC assets

**Participate in planning and successful implementation of strategic initiatives:**

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Collaborate with senior management in developing an organizational structure that will provide client service excellence in rapidly evolving changing organization (e.g. organizational planning)
* Participate in committees as a Subject Matter Expert and collaborate with various departments to drive change; oversee implementation of assigned initiatives and manage change process within own operating unit to ensure success
* Work with Leadership Team to implement Global Operations’ strategies and service excellence principles to enhance client satisfaction results
* Key relationships with a wide range of internal CIBC employees, teams and departments (e.g. Internal Audit, Branches) at peer level and up to Senior Management/Director levels to share information, ensure compliance and operational efficiencies, present strategies, recommend solutions and resolve issues

The Fund Operations team supports the Real Estate business through fund reporting, data management, investor communications, and operational processes. * Prepare and maintain property, asset, and portfolio-level attributes, historical information, and current data on a periodic basis.
* Upload and manage investor communications and key documentation through platforms such as Intralinks.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Deloitte USI - Consulting Services – Strategy Risky & Transactions – Specialist | Hyderabad**
