title: Vice President, Settlement & Currency Services
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Vice President, Settlement & Currency Services
  
  
**Overview:**
Settlement & Currency Services is Mastercard’s center of expertise for global settlement, cross-border payments, currency and foreign exchange services, and value movement across traditional and digital financial networks. The team supports initiatives related to fiat and digital currencies, settlement infrastructure, and emerging payment technologies, working across products, markets, and functions to advance strategic priorities. The team also develops solutions that enable funds movement between Mastercard customers, engages with regulators and manages relationships with commercial and central banks.
  
  
Mastercard is seeking an execution-focused Vice President, Settlement & Currency Services to lead settlement and FX capability development and implementation across AP & EEMEA. This role will prioritize regional initiatives, support regulatory reporting requirements, and help manage responses to regulatory inquiries.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Conducting thorough analysis to assess the financial, operational, regulatory, customer, and system impacts and requirements needed to support settlement/FX initiatives
* Collaborating with the global team on strategic efforts such as introducing new settlement and FX enhancements in AP & EEMEA region
* Partnering with business units to strategize, develop and implement enhancements to settlement service offerings, ensuring alignment with market needs and operational capabilities
* Driving initiatives to ensure liquidity availability for settlement in AP & EEMEA region
* Engaging with regulators, central banks, and other stakeholders in AP & EEMEA region to manage regulatory audits and inquiries related to Settlement and FX and staying abreast of regulatory changes and legal developments
* Overseeing the timely and accurate preparation and submission of regulatory reports related to Settlement activities, ensuring compliance with reporting requirements across jurisdictions
* Managing global settlement invoice processing including establishing new vendors, routing invoices for approvals/payment through Oracle, and triaging processing issues
* Ensuring that all project aspects are compliant with Mastercard policies and procedures
* Formulating and presenting strategic recommendations to executive management

**All About You:**

* Educational qualification: MBA or a degree in business or finance
* Proven track record in payment systems product/project management, including the implementation and maintenance of external systems or proprietary technology
* Demonstrated ability in leading high-impact transformation initiatives with strong project management and stakeholder management skills across global and cross-functional teams
* Advanced level of expertise in Treasury settlements / payment operations and banking infrastructure gained through experiences in multinational corporates’ Regional/Global Treasury centers, financial institutions or banks
* Proficient in payment network systems, including authorization, clearing, and settlement, and bank connectivity solutions like Host-to-host and SWIFT
* Significant experience managing regulatory correspondence on Settlement/Payment matters. Experience with payments‑related regulatory compliance requirements across APAC and EEMEA regulators like MAS, HKMA, ASIC, JFSA, RBI, PBOC, SARB is highly valuable while not mandatory
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to initiate and implement the needed changes to achieve business unit /corporate objectives
* Ability to think creatively and out-of-the box; ability to challenge the status quo; demonstrated ability to innovate
* Strong leadership qualities, including getting work done through others, being organizationally savvy, thought leadership
* Demonstrated ability to manage a diverse team with varying skillsets
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills, and proven ability to lead complex cross-functional projects
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, particularly the ability to work and communicate cross-functionally
* Management style that is proactive towards employee development

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
**Job Description**

* To achieve sales targets product-wise, value-wise both in primary and secondary sales on monthly as well as yearly basis for the assigned region.
* Maintain customer relationship and engage key stakeholders (i.e. Drs, Retailers, Stockist etc.) of the region through different customer engagement initiatives in line with our company strategy.
* Regularly review the performance of the team and region sales and accordingly prepare the action plan for their improvement.
* Take initiatives to train and develop the team members basis the gaps identified.
* Ensure strict implementation of credit policy in the region and control out-standings as per the company norms.
* Fill the vacancies (AM’s/ ME’s/ MT’s) in the team, within the stipulated time frame as per the company norms to avoid any sales loss.
* Facilitate in implementation of company strategies by the team members to ensure execution excellence.
* Provide market intelligence data on market conditions and effectiveness of promotional strategy of company’s products as well as that of competitors to the line managers and the marketing team.
* Manage the attrition within the team and ensure that the talent is retained.

Work Experience
  
  
Overall, 11-12 Years, Minimum 2 years of experience as a Second Line Manager

title: Manager - FP&A
description:
Job Purpose

To support the organization's financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis activities. The role will be responsible for generating actionable financial insights, monitoring business performance, evaluating profitability, and supporting management in strategic and operational decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

* Support the preparation and execution of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), annual budgets, and capital expenditure budgets.
* Prepare and monitor monthly and quarterly financial forecasts.
* Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support business planning and investment decisions.
* Analyze financial performance against budgets and forecasts and identify areas requiring corrective action.

2. Financial Analysis & Business Partnering

* Work closely with business and functional teams to understand financial performance and operational requirements.
* Analyze product, business segment, and cost profitability to identify opportunities for margin improvement.
* Conduct financial feasibility, ROI, and NPV analyses for business initiatives and capital investments.
* Provide financial insights to support business decisions and improve overall financial performance

3. MIS & Management Reporting

* Prepare monthly MIS reports, management dashboards, and financial performance summaries.
* Conduct variance analysis of actual performance against budget and forecasts.
* Track key financial and operational performance indicators.
* Present relevant financial insights and recommendations to management.

4. Process Improvement & Reporting

* Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
* Support automation of reports and enhance data accuracy and reporting efficiency.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely availability and accuracy of financial information.

Educational Qualification

* Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.

Experience

* 3–7 years of relevant experience in FP&A, financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, or financial analysis.
* Prior experience in a
  **manufacturing organization is mandatory**
  .

Technical Skills

* Strong financial modelling and analytical skills.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel.
* Working knowledge of SAP and financial planning/reporting tools.
* Experience in MIS reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, cost analysis, and profitability metrics.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates currently based in Delhi NCR only.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional stakeholders and manage multiple priorities.
* A data-driven approach with a strong focus on accuracy and business performance.

title: Sr Principal, Analyst (Semiconductor Memory – NAND Flash/DRAM)
description: About this Role:Analysts create must-have insights for our clients through published research and client interaction. You will meet with clients every day: on the phone, in a videoconference, from the stage at a Gartner event, or face-to-face during a sales support visit. In every interaction, you will help clients overcome their challenges and perform better.As part of Gartner’s Emerging Market Dynamics Group, you will equip leaders in the semiconductor memory industry with indispensable insights, advice, and tools to achieve their mission-critical priorities and build the successful organizations of tomorrow. You will own the authoritative quantitative view of the global DRAM, HBM and NAND Flash markets and convert supply, demand, pricing and technology signals into decision-useful market intelligence.What You’ll do:Develop and maintain global DRAM, HBM and NAND supply-demand forecasts, including bit growth, wafer capacity, utilization, yields, inventories and pricing. Track supplier capacity, capex, technology transitions and competitive positioning across Samsung, SK hynix, Micron, Kioxia, SanDisk and emerging suppliers. Forecast market size, revenue, units/bits, ASPs and supplier market share by major memory segment. Quantify demand across AI/data center, enterprise storage, PCs, smartphones, automotive and other major applications. Track DRAM technology transitions including DDR5, LPDDR and HBM generations, capacity allocation and HBM production economics. Track NAND transitions including layer scaling, TLC/QLC mix, enterprise SSD adoption, client SSD and embedded/mobile applications. Analyze memory cycles, inventory corrections, pricing inflections and structural supply-demand changes. Maintain quarterly market trackers, forecast models, source databases and scenario analysis. Provide evidence-based written responses and support VP/market-intelligence-level client conversations. Partner with analysts covering AI accelerators, foundry, advanced packaging and storage to quantify cross-market dependencies. Identify early indicators that could invalidate the current forecast and proactively revise assumptions and outlooks. Actively participate in appropriate Gartner global research communities for formal and in-formal knowledge sharing sessions. Core Quantitative Coverage :You are capable of modeling and forecasting:DRAM / HBM: wafer capacity and utilization, bit output and bit growth, die density and technology-node transitions, HBM stacks, capacity and GB/device, DDR/LPDDR/HBM mix, supplier market share, contract and spot pricing, revenue and ASP, and AI-server and accelerator-driven memory demand. NAND Flash: wafer capacity and utilization, bits/wafer and layer transitions, TLC/QLC mix, bit supply and demand, supplier market share, pricing and revenue, enterprise/client SSD units and capacity, mobile/embedded NAND, and AI-storage demand including RAG, KV-cache and checkpointing use cases. Research Boundaries: This role owns the semiconductor memory-market quantitative truth layer. It does not own broad AI accelerator strategy, semiconductor foundry strategy, advanced packaging market strategy, server/storage-system architecture, or the general semiconductor equipment coverage. However, the analyst must quantify how developments in these adjacent markets affect memory demand, supply and economics. Job Requirements :What You Will NeedEducational Qualification:BE/BTech from Grade A engineering colleges with specialization in Electronics, or Semiconductors, or software engineering. Graduate + MBA (Marketing or Ops) from leading A & B-schools is desirable. Work experience:7-10+ years minimum experience in semiconductor memory, market intelligence, product planning, business planning, forecasting or industry research. Domain knowledge/Business Acumen:Deep expertise in DRAM and/or NAND Flash, with the ability to develop credible coverage across both. Strong understanding of memory manufacturing economics, technology migration, supplier capacity and pricing cycles. Demonstrated ability to build and maintain quantitative market models and forecasts. Experience with memory suppliers, semiconductor market-research firms, OEMs/hyperscalers or relevant supply-chain organizations preferred. Awareness of the major issues across the IT, technology, semiconductor and electronics industry affecting software technologies and competitive landscape, and an eagerness to learn more. MS Office Tools:Ability to design, develop and maintain large Excel models for market share analysis and forecasting, and strong working knowledge of other MS Office tools such as Word and Power Point for writing and presenting analysis. Project management skills:Ability to manage time, keep projects on schedule and resolve issues and deliver all client deliverables in a timely manner. Communication skills:Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex market data into clear implications. Written: A strong writing ability is mandatory. Writing efforts will require stating/staking positions, justifying those positions with facts and providing actionable analysis and recommendations. Oral: Skills to converse on telephone, face to face, and on-stage, with the ability to explain complex concepts concisely. Problem Solving:Strong analytical skills and the ability to think creatively, independently, and efficiently to diagnose and contextualize issues, exhibit critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities, including working on estimation problems and provide insightful and original analysis. Interpersonal skills:Ability to communicate, engage, and develop cordial professional relationships with analysts, key initiative leaders, team managers, and clients with a compelling and enthusiastic attitude that drives clients to action and guides them to success. Strong client presence and ability to relate to a variety of company and personality types is a must - ability to represent Gartner research, methodology and strategies at multiple levels (Board, C-Level, Business Unit and Operational) and multiple client organization types (End User Client, Investors, Technology and Service Providers, Resellers, Channel Partners). Ability to organize effectively, drive for results, collaborate productively, coach and develop colleagues where required – provide constructive feedback to peers as well as be receptive to feedback from peers. Complete ownership mindset, professional maturity and intellectual curiosity, ability to embrace change and act with integrity, and follow internal processes and policies, including, HR, IT and Finance. Who you are :To thrive in this role, it helps if you are obsessed with your topic! Gartner analysts are correctly viewed as THE experts. This means that:You know your technologies, markets, vendors, trends, management practices, etc., well and be able to see the forest and the trees. You are an excellent collaborator with the ability to quickly build rapport and gain client trust. You are a confident presenter with a high level of executive presence (prior experience with speaking engagements is a plus). You are an analytical thinker with the ability to process information quickly and make actionable recommendations. You are willing to challenge conventional norms and views. Who are we? At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.What makes Gartner a great place to work? Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. title: Sr. Cost Manager - MEP
description:
**Job Description**
Undertake quantity works for Building projects - Residential, Commercial, Hotel, Hospital, Fitout, Industry / warehouse (depending on project requirement)
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Perform advanced quantification across complete MEP works Electrical, HVAC, Fire Fighting, Plumbing, DG, Lift, IBMS.
  
  
Draft or modify trade-specific preambles, quantify preliminaries and general items, review cost plan quantities, audit team measurements.
  
  
Apply suitable assumptions (when required) where project information is incomplete.
  
  
Lead preparation and review of cost plans at various stages and tender estimates.
  
  
Analyse and evaluate items of work unit rates to project specifics by incorporating risk factors.
  
  
Carryout benchmark against similar projects, price preliminaries, reconcile BOQs with budgets, and provide input on cost strategies, sustainability elements, and fee allowances.
  
  
Oversee and review pricing work prepared by junior team members.
  
  
Advise on procurement strategies and contract selection based on project needs. Draft or review special contract conditions, manage end-to-end tender processes, review documentation and reports, and present to Client.
  
  
Prepare formal correspondences such as letters of intent, award, or agreement. Provide guidance to junior team.
  
  
Oversee post-contract cost management, including review and approval of payment recommendations, cost reports, and cash flow forecasts and present to Client. Establish change control protocols, advise on risk mitigation, evaluate claims and variations, monitor expenditure of provisional sums, and review Final Account Statement.
  
  
Lead and support junior team members in cost control tasks.
  
  
Apply working knowledge of construction technologies and methods in cost planning tasks. Assess cost implications of materials, labour and construction methods during design and execution stages.
  
  
Should be proficient in CAD, Cost-X (qty take off tools) and other quantification / estimation software.
  
  
Good skills on MS excel and word and ability to learn and adapt to customized software
  
  
**Qualifications**
Qualification- Degree in Mechanical Engineering

title: Clinical Business Intelligence Manager
description:
**Clinical Business Intelligence Manager (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your deep expertise in healthcare analytics could directly influence how AI understands and reasons about clinical data? We're looking for an experienced Clinical Business Intelligence Manager to lead analytics work that sits at the intersection of healthcare intelligence and cutting-edge AI development.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for senior professionals who know how to turn complex clinical and operational data into decisions that matter. You'll bring your healthcare BI leadership experience to a team working on some of the most advanced AI projects in the industry.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and mentor a business intelligence team in building dashboards, reports, and analytics that support clinical and operational decision-making
* Design, maintain, and optimize BI infrastructure — including data models, SQL queries, and reporting pipelines — ensuring accuracy, reliability, and performance
* Analyze clinical, operational, and performance data to uncover meaningful trends and surface insights that support leadership decisions
* Translate complex healthcare datasets into clear, trusted outputs that drive improvements in care delivery and organizational efficiency
* Apply your domain expertise to evaluate, quality-check, and improve AI-generated outputs related to clinical analytics and healthcare data reasoning

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in healthcare or clinical analytics, business intelligence, or data management within regulated environments
* Proven track record designing and managing BI systems — including dashboards, reporting pipelines, and data models
* Comfortable working with clinical, operational, and administrative datasets and understanding their real-world implications
* Strong communicator who can translate technical findings into meaningful narratives for both clinical and operational stakeholders
* Self-directed and reliable — you deliver quality work independently without hand-holding

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with AI tools, LLM outputs, or AI training workflows
* Background in health informatics, population health, or value-based care analytics
* Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI platforms

**Why Join Us**

* Work alongside world-leading AI research labs on genuinely cutting-edge projects
* Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of meaningful, high-impact work
* Gain direct exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated
* Contribute clinical intelligence expertise to AI systems that will shape how healthcare data is understood at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Finance: Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe
description:
Job Title
  
  
Finance Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe
  
  
**Job Description**
Are you a finance professional with a strong background in tax, compliance, and financial governance? Do you enjoy combining technical expertise with team leadership, process improvement, and collaboration across multiple European countries?
  
  
At Vanderlande, we are looking for a Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe who will lead the regional Tax & Compliance team and help ensure a strong and compliant tax framework across our European operations.
  
  
In this role, you will contribute to managing tax risks, ensuring regulatory compliance, improving processes and controls, and supporting the business with practical tax solutions in a dynamic international environment.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**
As Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe, you report to the Team Lead Tax & Compliance EU / LATAM and lead a team of tax and compliance professionals supporting the European organization.
  
  
You will oversee day-to-day tax compliance activities within Europe and provide guidance on tax matters across multiple countries, working closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders.
  
  
You will combine solid tax expertise with people leadership and a continuous improvement mindset, ensuring tax compliance processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and consistently across the region.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you will
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop the Europe Tax & Compliance team.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of tax compliance and reporting activities across Europe.
* Coordinate corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and other relevant tax compliance activities in cooperation with Group Tax and local Finance teams.
* Support transfer pricing compliance activities and documentation requirements.
* Act as a key contact for tax authorities, auditors, external advisors, and internal stakeholders on operational tax matters.
* Identify and manage tax risks, ensuring issues are escalated and addressed appropriately.
* Translate changes in tax legislation into practical guidance and actions for the business.
* Maintain and improve tax controls, documentation, and compliance processes.
* Drive standardization and process improvements across European tax and compliance activities.
* Identify recurring issues and implement sustainable solutions.
* Support business projects and operational activities with practical tax advice.
* Contribute to finance transformation, compliance, and process improvement initiatives.
* Build strong relationships with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business teams.
* Support knowledge sharing and consistent application of Group Tax policies across Europe.

**What do we ask from you?**
We ask you to bring experience, education, and personality
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Tax, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in tax, tax compliance, or a related finance function within an international environment.
* Experience leading, coaching, or coordinating a team.
* Good knowledge of corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and general tax compliance requirements.
* Experience working with tax authorities, auditors, and external advisors.
* Experience with process improvement and standardization initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* A proactive, pragmatic, and solution-oriented mindset.
* A collaborative leader who combines technical expertise with a strong service-oriented approach.

**About The Team**
You will join the global FSSC organization and become part of a collaborative international finance community. The Europe Tax & Compliance team supports the region in meeting tax and regulatory obligations while helping the business operate efficiently and compliantly in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment.
  
  
The team works closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders to strengthen compliance, mitigate risks, and continuously improve ways of working.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer a position in an international and professional working environment with room for personal development and growth.
  
  
This position offers a competitive salary range of € 6.500 to € 7.600 gross per month (excluding 8% holiday allowance).
  
  
On top of your fixed salary, you’ll receive the following secondary benefits
  
  

* 40 vacation days (20 statutory days and a flexible budget worth 20 days)
* Flexible working hours
* A hybrid workplace (40% working from home and 60% in the office)
* A Health & Wellbeing budget worth € 300 per calendar year.
* Commuting allowance, including full reimbursement of travel by public transport
* Working from home allowance
* Collective pension scheme and discount on additional health insurance
* On-site company health centres with a gym, physiotherapists and occupational therapists
* Vanderlande Academy and training facilities to boost your skills
* A variety in Vanderlande Network communities and initiatives

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande designs, delivers and supports automation solutions, operational software and lifecycle services for leading airports and parcel operations worldwide. Our solutions help customers improve performance, reliability, and sustainable growth in more than 100 countries. How we work matters just as much as what we deliver. Our values, Every Day Better, We Care, and Team Play, guide how we collaborate, support each other, and create value for our customers.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV.
  
  
Questions about this role? Contact Carlijn Kneepkens (Recruiter) at carlijn.kneepkens@vanderlande.com.
  
  
**Diversity & inclusion**
Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Associate Vice President - SaT - TMT - SaT - TCF - M&A Advisory - New Delhi
description:
Requisition Id: 1754380
  
  
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
  
  
**The opportunity**
: Associate Vice President-TMT-SaT-SaT - TCF - M&A Advisory - New Delhi
  
  
**TMT :**
Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
  
  
We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.
  
  
**SaT - TCF - M&A Advisory :**
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to today’s toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
  
  
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
  
  
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**

* Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Investment Banking professional with strong sector expertise in IT Services and Technology, capable of independently leading M&A transactions end-to-end. The role requires a combination of transaction execution, analytical rigor, senior client management, team leadership and business development, with meaningful exposure to definitive agreement negotiations. Key Responsibilities M&A Transaction Execution Lead end-to-end execution of M&A transactions, from initial engagement and transaction positioning through diligence, negotiations, signing and closing. Manage all key aspects of the deal process, including financial analysis, valuation, transaction structuring, buyer / investor evaluation, diligence and process management. Coordinate across clients, prospective buyers / investors, legal counsel, accounting advisers and other transaction stakeholders. Work closely with legal advisers and clients through definitive agreement negotiations, including commercial and transaction-related considerations. Client Management Act as a key day-to-day point of contact for clients, independently managing client interactions across the transaction lifecycle. Build long-term relationships with founders, management teams, corporates and financial sponsors. Business Development & Origination Maintain a strong focus on business development and deal origination, particularly across the IT Services and broader Technology ecosystem. Identify actionable M&A opportunities through sector knowledge, market developments and client dialogue. Participate in senior-level pitches and new-business conversations. Sector Expertise & Analytical Thinking Bring deep understanding of the IT Services landscape, including key business models, industry trends, competitive dynamics and valuation drivers. Develop compelling equity stories and transaction positioning supported by robust financial and industry analysis. Team Leadership Manage and mentor a team of Associates and Senior Associates, providing direction across deal execution and business development. Review financial analyses, valuation work, transaction materials, presentations and other client deliverables. Take ownership of workstream prioritization and ensure high-quality, timely execution across multiple engagements. Candidate Profile Strong prior Investment Banking / M&A experience, preferably focused on IT Services, Technology Services or the broader Technology sector. Demonstrated ability to lead M&A transactions end-to-end with significant client-facing responsibility. Strong analytical, valuation and financial modelling capabilities, coupled with sound commercial judgment. Experience participating in definitive agreement negotiations and transaction documentation processes. Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* Master of Business Administration
* Post Graduate Diploma in Management

**Experience**

* investment banking (5+ years)

**What We Look For**
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
  
  
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
  
  
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

title: Sr. Executive- MIS Inventory
description:
**Job description**

**Company Name: Krishi Cress**

**About The Company:**

Krishi Cress is a provider of fresh farm produce, including salad greens, seasonal fruits, edible flowers, and everyday veggies, to homes and restaurants in Delhi-NCR. Partnering with farms across North India, Krishi Cress ensures a wide variety of exotic and delicious foods are always available through its online store. Additionally, Krishi Cress offers a range of farm products like freshly-brewed Kombucha and artisanal cheese, aiming to promote local foods and Indian ingredients while supporting farmers with knowledge and technology.

**Job Location: Chhatarpur, New Delhi**

**Job Title: Sr. Executive – MIS Inventory**

**Product Range- F&V/ FMCG**

**Key Responsibilities**

·   Prepare daily, weekly and monthly inventory MIS reports.

·   Maintain accurate records of stock received, issued, transferred, returned and available.

·   Track inward and outward entries and verify inventory data against physical stock and system records.

·   Monitor stock levels, stock movement, wastage, shortages and discrepancies, and report variances promptly.

·   Prepare inventory dashboards and reports on stock availability, ageing and movement.

·   Coordinate with warehouse, operations, purchase and accounts teams for data verification and reconciliation.

·   Ensure timely and accurate data entry in Excel and relevant inventory/ERP systems.

·   Support regular stock audits and reconcile physical inventory with recorded balances.

·   Share timely reports with management and prepare ad-hoc inventory reports as required.

**Required Skills**

·   Strong MS Excel skills – Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS and related formulas.

·   Good analytical, reporting and data reconciliation skills.

·   Strong attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining records.

·   Good communication and coordination skills.

·   Experience with inventory management software, ERP or warehouse systems will be an advantage.

·   Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts, as per business requirements.

·   Zoho- Inventory knowledge is plus.

**Candidate Profile**

·   Graduate in any relevant discipline.

·   1–3 years of experience in Inventory MIS, Inventory Coordination, Warehouse Reporting or a similar role.

**Experience: 1–3 years**

**Preferred Industry: Any; experience in warehousing, logistics or inventory operations is preferred.**

**Specific Skills required: Advanced Excel**

**Salary Range: 25000-35000 (As per skills and interview)**

**To Apply:**

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter to hr@krishicress.com with the subject line “Application – MIS Executive – Inventory”.

**Note:**

This JD is indicative and not exhaustive. You may be given additional responsibilities as per business needs and new challenges to enhance your role, which will be appropriately appreciated. Teamwork is an important part of our culture, and it is important to help each other grow together.

title: Assistant Analyst, Property Tax
description:
In a world of disruption and increasingly complex business challenges, our professionals bring truth into focus with the Kroll Lens. Our sharp analytical skills, paired with the latest technology, allow us to give our clients clarity—not just answers—in all areas of business. We embrace diverse backgrounds and global perspectives, and we cultivate diversity by respecting, including, and valuing one another. As part of One team, One Kroll, you’ll contribute to a supportive and collaborative work environment that empowers you to excel.
  
  
Kroll’s global Property Tax Services practice assists clients in identifying tax saving opportunities by reviewing their tangible property portfolio and associated property tax assessments and liabilities.
  
  
At Kroll, your work will help deliver clarity to our clients’ most complex governance, risk, and transparency challenges. Apply now to join One team, One Kroll.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Set up and maintain client data (Legal Entities, Properties, Accounts/Parcels, Assets)
* Review client information for completeness and integrity
* Monitor the current laws, trends and techniques relative to property tax requirements and property valuation to afford the client the most legally advantageous status
* Ensure all tasks are completed in a timely manner and deadlines are met
* Ability to maintain positive client relationships and ensure that all clients' needs are met
* Research and consult with collectors and assessors on various property tax issues
* Research and process tax bills and property tax notices
* Ability to help the Lead coordinate and prioritize assignments and deadlines for team
* Stay informed on property tax procedures by participating in training sessions and educational opportunities
* Prepare the estimated property tax liability accruals of the client
* Initiate data requests (properties, accounts, assets) from clients and follow up

**Requirements**

* Post Graduate or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business or related field
* Ability to communicate and interact effectively with co-workers and clients
* Working knowledge of personal computer and multiple software applications used in job functions including Intermediate MS Excel and MS Word
* Ability to collaborate with leads and other team members
* Demonstrate the ability to obtain technical expertise in the managed field
* Ability to problem solve and make educated decisions
* Flexible to meet the business and client expectations
* Strong organizational skills & attention to details
* Team-player, customer-centric attitude
* Ability to manage confidential, sensitive information

In order to be considered for a position at Kroll you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com
  
  
Kroll is committed to equal opportunity and diversity, and recruits people based on merit

title: Financial Analyst-MAI
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial statements, and corporate financial disclosures
* Working knowledge of US GAAP, local accounting standards, and/or IFRS
* Ability to analyze company filings, including annual reports, Form 10-K filings, interim reports, regulatory filings, and solvency reports
* High attention to detail, with strong analytical, quality-control, and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to organize multiple priorities, meet deadlines, take initiative, and work independently within a global team
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, together with advanced Microsoft Excel capability, including pivot tables and lookup functions

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, CFA- Level 1 candidates preferred
* 0 – 2 years of experience analyzing financial statements or performing related financial research
* Hands-on experience extracting relevant data and insights from published financial documents is preferred

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze global corporate financial disclosures to extract accurate, decision-ready financial data and insights
* Analyze published financial documents and extract relevant financial data, insights, and supporting information
* Review income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements from annual, interim, and regulatory filings across geographies
* Apply accounting knowledge and financial statement analysis to interpret company disclosures accurately and consistently
* Conduct detailed quality checks on assigned work and, when required, review the work of others
* Deliver accurate outputs within established timelines and quality standards
* Perform secondary research to clarify disclosures and support data extraction and analysis
* Collaborate with research analysts, subject-matter experts, senior research analysts, and global colleagues
* Work independently, manage priorities effectively, and contribute to continuous improvement in data quality and usability

**About The Team**
The Digital Insights team supports an initiative designed to strengthen recognition of Moody’s value proposition among financial-market participants. The team focuses on financial data governance and on improving the quality and usability of data in Moody’s products
  
  
By joining the team, you will analyze financial documents from corporate entities worldwide and collaborate with a global group of research analysts, subject-matter experts, and senior research analysts
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

* Basic understanding and interest in financial services, digital solutions, innovations and related macro trends
* Intellectual curiosity along with strong analytical capability and problem-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.

**Your Impact**
You will take ownership of core Treasury operations, providing regional Treasury coverage for a subset of our global offices and supporting their cash management, payments and reimbursements, regional investments, and other banking needs.

title: Senior Associate, Performance Improvement
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
  
  
The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
  
  
Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.
  
  
The Senior Associate, Performance Improvement (PI) role at Portage Point represents a unique opportunity to assume a wide range of responsibilities and make a significant impact. The Senior Associate, PI is a key contributor helping to conduct analysis and identify value creation opportunities. This Senior Associate will support engagements that enhance efficiency, accuracy and decision-making for clients facing complex financial, transactional and operational challenges. This person will support key initiatives, execute discrete workstreams and collaborate closely with senior leaders. If you thrive in a high-performance culture and want to help build the future of a rapidly growing consultancy, this is the right role for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support commercial and operational due diligence, including deep-dive analysis of commercial opportunities, cost structures, working capital and operational KPIs
* Perform detailed data analysis and root-cause diagnostics across functions such as procurement, supply chain, manufacturing and SG&A
* Build and maintain robust financial and operational models, including cash flow, liquidity and cost-saving tracking tools
* Assist in developing 100-day plans and value creation roadmaps with clearly defined initiatives and impact estimates
* Track and report value capture initiatives, including savings realization and EBITDA impact
* Prepare high-quality client-ready materials for global stakeholders under tight timelines
* Partner with senior executives, private equity firms, lenders, lawyers and other related buyers
* Collaborate with U.S.-based teams to ensure alignment and seamless execution across time zones
* Contribute to a high-performing, inclusive and values-driven culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or CA preferred
* Experience working with U.S.-based private equity or corporate clients
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* At least three years of experience in consulting, transaction advisory or corporate strategy / operations
* Strong exposure to operational improvement, cost reduction or restructuring environments
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with large datasets and financial modeling required
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Analyst/Specialist, Institutional Portfolio Operations (ABC)
description:
When you join the Institutional Portfolio Operations (IPO) team as a Specialist, you are joining a group of tightknit, energetic, and social individuals, who together have a direct impact on the investment success of individuals, pension funds, foundations and endowments, First Nations and other institutional clients.
  
  
The Specialist on the Institutional Portfolio Operations team is a critical part of our firm and clients’ success and is a challenging and rewarding role for the right individual. You will experience the inter-workings of the asset management world and will have the opportunity to advance your skills for future growth and development within Connor, Clark & Lunn (CC&L).
  
  
**What You Will Do**
The Specialist, Institutional Portfolio Operations serves as the key provider of accurate investment portfolio data to the entire CC&L family and their clients. In this role, you will:
  
  

* Institutional Billing: Prepare and issue management fee invoices for institutional clients, funds, and affiliated entities on both a monthly and quarterly basis.
* Assets Under Management (AUM) Reporting: Administrator the AUM reporting process by producing monthly and quarterly reports and supporting data requests from Investment Teams, Sales, RFP, and Senior Management.
* Operational Projects: Contribute to initiatives focused on automation, process efficiency, and enhancing the scalability of IPO’s service offerings.
* Information Management: Communicate critical portfolio details and manage the secure flow of sensitive information across all CC&L affiliates.

**What You Will Bring**

* Investment Knowledge: You have an undergraduate degree in business administration, commerce or a related field and a genuine interest in the investment industry.
* Industry knowledge: A minimum of 2 years of experience in an institutional investment firm, bank or trust company, where you have acquired operational expertise. Fund accounting experience is considered a strong asset.
* Collaborative Communication: You can articulate yourself clearly through both verbal and written mediums and work well with others to resolve complex issues.
* Inquisitive Mind: You have the ability to think rationally, and problem solve effectively.
* Team Player: You are committed to contributing and supporting a team of like-minded individuals who are driven and have high standards. Everyone you have worked with has wonderful things to say about you.
* Positive Attitude: You are a sharp, self-motivated, ambitious, and enthusiastic person who will seek to improve existing processes and help to implement creative solutions. You are a “go-getter.”
* Technical Skills: Proficient with financial software platforms, particularly those used for portfolio accounting and client invoicing, with additional experience in Excel VBA, Power BI, and Smartsheet. Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and strong proficiency in Word, Outlook, and Adobe applications.

title: Marketplace Finance & Reconciliation Executive
description:
Position: Marketplace Finance & Reconciliation Executive
  
  
Location: Gurugram
  
  
️ Working Days: Monday to Friday
  
  
Experience Required: 2-4 years
  
  
**Role Overview**
Our client is looking for a detail-oriented finance professional to independently manage marketplace reconciliations, payment tracking, stock reconciliation, TDS workings and channel-wise P&L—ensuring accurate reporting, timely closure and recovery of outstanding payments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Marketplace Reconciliation: Reconcile orders, sales, settlements, commissions, returns, refunds, cancellations and deductions.
* Payment Tracking & Follow-ups: Monitor payouts, investigate short payments and follow up with marketplace teams on pending payments and claims.
* Monthly Closure: Drive timely reconciliation closure, maintain ageing of open items and resolve outstanding mismatches.
* TDS & Tax Workings: Prepare and reconcile TDS workings; coordinate with the internal finance team on accounting and compliance.
* Stock Reconciliation: Match marketplace inventory with warehouse records and track lost, damaged or unaccounted stock.
* Marketplace P&L: Prepare channel-wise profitability reports covering sales, commissions, advertising, logistics, returns and other costs.
* MIS & Coordination: Maintain accurate trackers and work with KAMs, operations, warehouse and finance teams to resolve discrepancies.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 2-4 years of experience in finance, accounting or reconciliation; e-commerce/D2C experience preferred.
* Hands-on experience with platforms such as Amazon, Myntra, Flipkart, Nykaa or Blinkit.
* Good understanding of marketplace settlement cycles, commissions, deductions, returns, claims and TDS.
* Strong Excel skills: Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS and data analysis.
* High attention to detail, ownership, structured follow-ups and ability to meet monthly closure timelines.

IDEAL CANDIDATE
  
  
A proactive finance professional who can own marketplace financial operations end to end, identify revenue leakages, recover pending payments, close reconciliation gaps and deliver reliable profitability insights.

8. Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with marketing, product, tech, finance, and operations teams to track progress on key strategic and AI initiatives.

**Description**
Qatar Airways is recruiting for the role of
**Cargo Export Control Manager**
based at our Global Business Services (GBS) in Ahmedabad, Gujarat (India).
  
  
The Cargo Export Control Manager will lead and manage the day-to-day implementation, oversight and continuous improvement of Qatar Airways Cargo’s export controls and sanctions compliance programme across the global cargo network. The role will ensure that requirements relating to dual-use, military and strategic goods, controlled technology, restricted end-use and end-users, destination controls and sanctions screening are embedded within cargo booking, acceptance, documentation, escalation and shipment-handling processes. The successful candidate will provide practical specialist guidance to the Cargo Compliance Support Center (CCSC), Cargo Operations, Commercial teams, Ground Handling Agents and outstations, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, escalated and managed consistently and effectively.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the implementation and maintenance of export-control and sanctions policies, procedures, screening rules, commodity controls and escalation workflows across Qatar Airways Cargo operations globally.
* Assess high-risk shipments involving dual-use, military, strategic or otherwise controlled goods and recommend appropriate operational, legal or compliance action.
* Manage sanctions-screening governance, including list matching, false-positive resolution, potential-match escalation and the implementation of applicable regulatory controls.
* Conduct and oversee end-user, end-use, consignee, intermediate-consignee and destination-risk assessments, ensuring decisions are supported by clear and complete records
* Interpret regulatory requirements and provide commercially practical guidance to Cargo Operations, Commercial teams, outstations, Ground Handling Agents and other relevant stakeholders.
* Review export-control and sanctions incidents, exceptions and investigations; identify root causes; and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented and closed effectively.
* Govern screening criteria, system rules and enhancements, and drive automation and continuous improvement of export-control and sanctions processes.
* Monitor compliance performance through quality reviews, audits, KPIs, dashboards, trend analysis and management reporting, escalating material risks in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with the Cargo Sanctions and Crisis Manager, Legal, Security, Customs and other stakeholders on complex or sensitive matters.
* Provide functional leadership, coaching and operational direction to assigned resources; allocate work, monitor quality and progress, manage time-sensitive escalations and support capability development.

**Be part of an extraordinary story**
Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.

Together, everything is possible
  
  
Qualification

* A strong candidate will have at least six years of relevant experience, including supervisory, specialist or compliance-advisory responsibility.

title: Manager / Sr. Executive – Affiliate & Brand Alliances (Beauty / D2C)
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an owner who can scale affiliate, cashback, coupon and fintech/super-app partnerships into a core revenue channel. The goal is low-CAC incremental sales and new-customer acquisition across our D2C website and marketplace.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Affiliate Programs
* Build and scale the in-house D2C affiliate program on Shopify Plus, covering partner onboarding, tracking links, payouts and fraud control.
* Manage third-party affiliate networks and portals (Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission, Impact, etc.) and continuously add new publishers.
* Onboard influencers, creators, content/review sites and deal communities as affiliate partners.
* Cashback & Coupon Ecosystem
* Build partnerships and run campaigns with cashback portals (CashKaro, GoPaisa, etc.) and coupon portals (GrabOn, CouponDunia, etc.).
* Own the brand-wise coupon strategy: code structure, discount depth, exclusivity, leakage control, and monitoring of coupon abuse and brand-bidding.
* Super-App & Rewards Partnerships
* Launch offers, coupons, rewards and co-branded campaigns on platforms such as PhonePe, Paytm, Google Pay and Zomato.
* Explore new platforms and bank, fintech and loyalty partnerships that bring in high-intent customers.
* Planning & Campaigns
* Create a partner-wise campaign calendar for launches, festive sales (Diwali, BFCM, EOSS) and key SKUs.
* Negotiate commission structures: CPS/CPA, tiered, performance-linked and exclusive deals.
* Tracking, Analytics & Reporting
* Track clicks, orders, AOV, new vs. repeat customers, CAC, ROAS, commission payouts and incrementality.
* Ensure accurate attribution (UTM, coupon-level, network-level) and catch fake or duplicate conversions.
* Build weekly/monthly dashboards and partner scorecards; pause low performers and scale winners.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Work with Brand, Performance Marketing, E-commerce, Creative, Finance and Tech teams on offers, creatives, tracking setup and payout reconciliation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce or a related field (MBA/PGDM preferred).
* 3–6 years of experience in affiliate, partnerships, performance or e-commerce marketing. Beauty, D2C or FMCG background preferred.
* Hands-on experience with affiliate networks/platforms (Impact, Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission) and cashback/coupon portals.
* Strong understanding of coupon-led and offer-led growth (CPS/CPA, margin math, abuse control).
* Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-management skills.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; working knowledge of GA4 and Shopify analytics.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with super-app/fintech offer platforms (PhonePe, Paytm, GPay, Zomato) or bank/credit-card reward partnerships.
* Understanding of marketplace affiliate programs (Amazon, Nykaa).

Success Metrics (first 6–12 months)
  
  

* Share of revenue and new-customer count from the affiliate/partnership channel.
* Blended CAC and ROAS within target.
* Number of active partners and top-partner concentration.
* Minimal coupon leakage and invalid payouts.

title: GENERAL MANAGER – AURAWILL BUSINESS
description:
We're Hiring: General Manager – Aurawill

📍 Location: Coimbatore

🏢 Full-time | On-site

Aurawill is one of India's fastest-growing nutrition brands, making traditional, science-backed nutrition simple and accessible for modern families.

In just over a year, we've earned the trust of 1,00,000+ customers and are expanding rapidly across D2C, marketplaces, quick-commerce and retail.

Aurawill is looking for a strong commercial General Manager to own the Brand’s business end-to-end and take responsibility for scaling the brand profitably. This role is for someone who is ready to own the full business rather than a single functional vertical.

**The Opportunity**

Aurawill is a natural health foods brand with an ambition to build a differentiated, trusted and scalable consumer business. The General Manager will be responsible for translating the brand ambition into business growth i.e owning the P&L, shaping strategy, setting priorities and leading the teams and functions required to deliver the plan.

**What You Will Own**

**· P&L and Business Strategy:**
Own the overall Aurawill P&L and business plan; set revenue, gross margin, contribution, profitability and growth priorities; identify the biggest business levers and allocate resources and budgets accordingly.

**· Sales channels:**
Own the D2C channel and other online/offline channels of business end-to-end including acquisition, retention, and channel profitability. Build a scalable growth engine rather than optimising only for topline.

**· Marketing & Brand:**
Partner closely with the marketing team to translate the brand strategy into consumer growth. Own the commercial outcomes of marketing investments while protecting long-term brand equity, positioning and consumer relevance.

**· Supply Chain & Operations:**
Own the operating rhythm from demand planning and procurement through production, inventory, fulfilment, quality and customer experience.

**· Finance & Business Management:**
Work closely with finance to build budgets, forecasts, monthly business reviews, scenario building and investment cases.

**· People & Organisation:**
Lead and align cross-functional teams across sales, marketing, supply chain, finance, operations and other business-critical functions. Build a high-accountability culture with clear goals, ownership and operating cadence.

**· Growth & Innovation:**
Identify new consumer needs, occasions, products, channels and partnerships that can materially expand the business.

**What We Are Looking For**

· Owned a D2C business, category, brand, business unit with full P&L responsibility.

· Strong general-management orientation: able to lead revenue, margins, operations and people rather than operating only within one function.

· Demonstrated ownership of business numbers and comfort being accountable for revenue, gross margin, contribution and profitability.

· Strong understanding of D2C growth & metrics - acquisition, conversion, retention, repeat, CAC, blended CAC, LTV, AOV & Channel mix.

· Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders across marketing, sales, supply chain, finance and operations.

· Strong commercial judgement: able to distinguish between growth that creates value and growth that merely creates topline.

· Comfort working in an entrepreneurial environment with hands on experience where resources and budgets are tight

· Data-fluent and financially rigorous, while retaining strong instinct for consumer and market.

· High ownership, speed of decision-making and willingness to execute when needed.

· A Tamil Speaking professional, preferably who lives in Tamil Nadu

**Ideal Background:**

We are interested in candidates who may currently be working as a D2C / E-commerce lead, Category Head, Growth Head, India Market lead or an equivalent role in a consumer business.

Minimum 5-6 years of relevant experience from D2C-first consumer brands, FMCG, food & beverage, health & wellness, beauty & personal care, nutrition, consumer tech or other categories where the candidate has had genuine commercial ownership and proven cross-functional leadership for a few years.

Entreprenuers who have built and scaled consumer businesses in the past are also welcome to apply.

*Preferred but not mandatory:*
From Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school in India

**What you will get from us:**

· Complete ownership and responsibility of business coupled with people leadership responsibility for a new-age brand that wants to build strong equity in the foods and nutrition business

· Freedom to experiment and decision-making autonomy

· A company with humble-people with good intention and make good quality products that serve consumer health

**The right candidate:**

This role is for someone who wants to build a business, not simply manage a function; be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and be willing to take ownership when something is not working.

* Must be able to hold the energy & range to discuss brand positioning in the morning, review a P&L in the afternoon, challenge inventory assumptions, diagnose a D2C funnel and align a cross-functional team around the next growth priority. The ability to zoom in and out is central to this role.

title: City Head
description:
**City PnL Head – Coliving**

**Zolo | Coliving Business**

Own the city. Drive occupancy. Build systems. Deliver predictable growth.

**Why this role exists**

In coliving, a city is not just a geography.

It is a full business unit with its own demand, occupancy, cost structure, customer experience, and operational complexity.

At city level:

* Demand fluctuates continuously
* Supply is fragmented across multiple properties
* Resident expectations evolve constantly
* Execution gaps immediately affect occupancy and retention

Without strong city-level ownership, operations quickly become reactive.

The biggest failures usually happen when:

* Occupancy is managed week-to-week instead of structurally
* Sales and operations work independently instead of as one system
* Cost leakages go unnoticed
* Accountability weakens across teams
* Escalations consume operational bandwidth daily

As scale increases, the city must operate with:

* Predictability
* Commercial discipline
* Structured execution
* Strong leadership ownership

This role exists to ensure:

* The city runs like a disciplined business unit
* Occupancy remains stable across cycles
* Demand generation stays strong and diversified
* Resident experience remains consistent across properties
* Costs are controlled structurally, not reactively
* Teams operate with ownership and accountability
* Escalations reduce through system-led fixes

If this role is strong:

* Occupancy becomes predictable
* Margins improve consistently
* Teams operate independently and efficiently
* Retention strengthens
* Growth becomes scalable

If this role is weak:

* Occupancy volatility increases
* Conversion weakens
* Costs rise without control
* Escalations dominate operations
* Customer experience becomes inconsistent

This role directly controls:
**Revenue + occupancy + retention + profitability + team performance**

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own city-level revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* Build strong demand generation engines
* Ensure consistent resident experience across properties
* Drive renewals and improve retention
* Control operational costs and eliminate leakages
* Build high-performing sales and operations teams
* Reduce escalations structurally through systems

**This is not a coordination role. This is a full city P&L ownership role.**

**About Coliving – Zolo**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Coliving works only when:

* Demand remains strong
* Occupancy stays high
* Resident experience remains consistent
* Operations are disciplined
* Costs stay under control

At scale:
**City becomes the core operating unit of the business.**

This role directly impacts:
**Revenue + occupancy + retention + operational efficiency + profitability**

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Own City Business Performance (P&L Ownership)**

* Own city-level revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* Track daily occupancy, booking trends, and pipeline visibility
* Drive predictable performance across properties
* Improve operational and commercial efficiency continuously
* Think in business outcomes, not activities

**2. Build Demand Generation & Sales Performance**

* Build strong local demand channels:
* Colleges
* Corporates
* Brokers
* Local partnerships
* Improve lead-to-booking conversion across the funnel
* Track funnel performance actively:
* Leads
* Visits
* Bookings
* Reduce funnel leakage systematically
* Ensure strong alignment between sales and occupancy goals

**3. Drive Operations & Resident Experience Excellence**

* Ensure SOP adherence across all properties
* Maintain consistent resident experience standards
* Track complaint patterns and escalation trends
* Drive audits and operational improvements proactively
* Ensure operational discipline across teams

**4. Improve Occupancy & Retention**

* Maintain stable occupancy across seasonal cycles
* Drive renewals and reduce churn proactively
* Identify early retention risk signals
* Improve resident continuity and relationship quality
* Ensure smooth admission and move-in experience

**5. Ensure Cost Control & Commercial Discipline**

* Track property-level cost vs budget consistently
* Identify operational leakages proactively
* Ensure vendor discipline and commercial accountability
* Balance resident experience with cost efficiency
* Drive profitability without compromising core standards

**6. Build Strong Teams & Leadership Depth**

* Lead city-level sales and operations teams
* Set targets and review performance regularly
* Build second-line leadership capability
* Act decisively on underperformance
* Create a strong ownership and accountability culture

**7. Handle Escalations & Operational Risks**

* Handle critical resident, parent, or safety escalations calmly
* Ensure structured issue resolution and follow-through
* Reduce repeat escalations through root-cause fixes
* Protect resident trust and brand reputation
* Maintain operational stability during pressure situations

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Occupancy becomes stable and predictable
